verses.translation: Or, She is identical with Lord Kṛṣṇa, for She embodies the mellows of love. The energy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is identical with Him.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Kṛṣṇa-mayī
has two different imports. First, a person who always thinks of Kṛṣṇa both within and without and who always remembers only Kṛṣṇa, wherever he goes or whatever he sees, is called
kṛṣṇa-mayī.
Also, since Kṛṣṇa's personality is full of love, His loving potency, Rādhārāṇī, being nondifferent from Him, is called
kṛṣṇa-mayī.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণবাঞ্ছা-পূর্তিরূপ করে আরাধনে ।\\nঅতএব ‘রাধিকা’ নাম পুরাণে বাখানে ॥৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-vāñchā-pūrti-rūpa kare ārādhane\\nataeva 'rādhikā' nāma purāṇe vākhāne
verses.translation: Her worship [ārādhana] consists of fulfilling the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore the Purāṇas call Her Rādhikā.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The name Rādhā is derived from the root word
ārādhana,
which means "worship." The personality who excels all in worshiping Kṛṣṇa may therefore be called Rādhikā, the greatest servitor.

verses.devanagari: অনয়ারাধিতো নূনং ভগবান্ হরিরীশ্বরঃ ।\\nযন্নো বিহায় গোবিন্দঃ প্রীতো যামনয়দ্রহঃ ॥৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: anayārādhito nūnaṁ\\nbhagavān harir īśvaraḥ\\nyan no vihāya govindaḥ\\nprīto yām anayad rahaḥ
verses.translation: "Truly the Personality of Godhead has been worshiped by Her. Therefore Lord Govinda, being pleased, has brought Her to a lonely spot, leaving us all behind."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.30.28).

verses.devanagari: অতএব সর্বপূজ্যা, পরম-দেবতা ।\\nসর্বপালিকা, সর্ব-জগতের মাতা ॥৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva sarva-pūjyā, parama-devatā\\nsarva-pālikā, sarva jagatera mātā
verses.translation: Therefore Rādhā is parama-devatā, the supreme goddess, and She is worshipable for everyone. She is the protectress of all, and She is the mother of the entire universe.

verses.devanagari: ‘সর্বলক্ষ্মী’-শব্দ পূর্বে করিয়াছি ব্যাখ্যান ।\\nসর্বলক্ষ্মীগণের তিহোঁ হন অধিষ্ঠান ॥৯০॥
verses.transliteration: 'sarva-lakṣmī'-śabda pūrve kariyāchi vyākhyāna\\nsarva-lakṣmī-gaṇera tiṅho hana adhiṣṭhāna
verses.translation: I have already explained the meaning of "sarva-lakṣmī." Rādhā is the original source of all the goddesses of fortune.

verses.devanagari: কিম্বা, ‘সর্বলক্ষ্মী’ — কৃষ্ণের ষড়্বিধ ঐশ্বর্য ।\\nতাঁর অধিষ্ঠাত্রী শক্তি — সর্বশক্তিবর্য ॥৯১॥
verses.transliteration: kimvā, 'sarva-lakṣmī'—kṛṣṇera ṣaḍ-vidha aiśvarya\\ntāṅra adhiṣṭhātrī śakti—sarva-śakti-varya
verses.translation: Or "sarva-lakṣmī" indicates that She fully represents the six opulences of Kṛṣṇa. Therefore She is the supreme energy of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: সর্ব-সৌন্দর্য-কান্তি বৈসয়ে যাঁহাতে ।\\nসর্বলক্ষ্মীগণের শোভা হয় যাঁহা হৈতে ॥৯২॥
verses.transliteration: sarva-saundarya-kānti vaisaye yāṅhāte\\nsarva-lakṣmī-gaṇera śobhā haya yāṅhā haite
verses.translation: The word "sarva-kānti" indicates that all beauty and luster rest in Her body. All the lakṣmīs derive their beauty from Her.

verses.devanagari: কিংবা ‘কান্তি’-শব্দে কৃষ্ণের সব ইচ্ছা কহে ।\\nকৃষ্ণের সকল বাঞ্ছা রাধাতেই রহে ॥৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: kimvā 'kānti'-śabde kṛṣṇera saba icchā kahe\\nkṛṣṇera sakala vāñchā rādhātei rahe
verses.translation: "Kānti" may also mean "all the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa." All the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa rest in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

verses.devanagari: রাধিকা করেন কৃষ্ণের বাঞ্ছিত পূরণ ।\\n‘সর্বকান্তি’-শব্দের এই অর্থ বিবরণ ॥৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: rādhikā karena kṛṣṇera vāñchita pūraṇa\\n'sarva-kānti'-śabdera ei artha vivaraṇa
verses.translation: Śrīmatī Rādhikā fulfills all the desires of Lord Kṛṣṇa. This is the meaning of "sarva-kānti."

verses.devanagari: জগৎমোহন কৃষ্ণ, তাঁহার মোহিনী ।\\nঅতএব সমস্তের পরা ঠাকুরাণী ॥৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: jagat-mohana kṛṣṇa, tāṅhāra mohinī\\nataeva samastera parā ṭhākurāṇī
verses.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa enchants the world, but Śrī Rādhā enchants even Him. Therefore She is the supreme goddess of all.

verses.devanagari: রাধা — পূর্ণশক্তি, কৃষ্ণ — পূর্ণশক্তিমান্ ।\\nদুই বস্তু ভেদ নাই, শাস্ত্র-পরমাণ ॥৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā—pūrṇa-śakti, kṛṣṇa—pūrṇa-śaktimān\\ndui vastu bheda nāi, śāstra-paramāṇa
verses.translation: Śrī Rādhā is the full power, and Lord Kṛṣṇa is the possessor of full power. The two are not different, as evidenced by the revealed scriptures.

verses.devanagari: মৃগমদ, তার গন্ধ — যৈছে অবিচ্ছেদ ।\\nঅগ্নি, জ্বালাতে — যৈছে কভু নাহি ভেদ ॥৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: mṛgamada, tāra gandha—yaiche aviccheda\\nagni, jvālāte—yaiche kabhu nāhi bheda
verses.translation: They are indeed the same, just as musk and its scent are inseparable, or as fire and its heat are nondifferent.

verses.devanagari: রাধাকৃষ্ণ ঐছে সদা একই স্বরূপ ।\\nলীলারস আস্বাদিতে ধরে দুইরূপ ॥৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-kṛṣṇa aiche sadā eka-i svarūpa\\nlīlā-rasa āsvādite dhare dui-rūpa
verses.translation: Thus Rādhā and Lord Kṛṣṇa are one, yet They have taken two forms to enjoy the mellows of pastimes.

verses.devanagari: প্রেমভক্তি শিখাইতে আপনে অবতরি ।\\nরাধা-ভাব-কান্তি দুই অঙ্গীকার করি’ ॥৯৯॥\\nশ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যরূপে কৈল অবতার ।\\nএই ত’ পঞ্চম শ্লোকের অর্থ পরচার ॥১০০॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-rūpe kaila avatāra\\nei ta' pañcama ślokera artha paracāra
verses.translation: To promulgate prema-bhakti [devotional service in love of Godhead], Kṛṣṇa appeared as Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya with the mood and complexion of Śrī Rādhā. Thus I have explained the meaning of the fifth verse.

verses.devanagari: ষষ্ঠ শ্লোকের অর্থ করিতে প্রকাশ ।\\nপ্রথমে কহিয়ে সেই শ্লোকের আভাস ॥১০১॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭha ślokera artha karite prakāśa\\nprathame kahiye sei ślokera ābhāsa
verses.translation: To explain the sixth verse, I shall first give a hint of its meaning.

verses.devanagari: অবতরি’ প্রভু প্রচারিল সংকীর্তন ।\\nএহো বাহ্য হেতু, পূর্বে করিয়াছি সূচন ॥১০২॥
verses.transliteration: avatari' prabhu pracārila saṅkīrtana\\neho bāhya hetu, pūrve kariyāchi sūcana
verses.translation: The Lord came to propagate saṅkīrtana. That is an external purpose, as I have already indicated.

verses.devanagari: অবতারের আর এক আছে মুখ্যবীজ ।\\nরসিকশেখর কৃষ্ণের সেই কার্য নিজ ॥১০৩॥
verses.transliteration: avatārera āra eka āche mukhya-bīja\\nrasika-śekhara kṛṣṇera sei kārya nija
verses.translation: There is a principal cause for Lord Kṛṣṇa's appearance. It grows from His own engagements as the foremost enjoyer of loving exchanges.

verses.devanagari: অতি গূঢ় হেতু সেই ত্রিবিধ প্রকার ।\\nদামোদরস্বরূপ হৈতে যাহার প্রচার ॥১০৪॥
verses.transliteration: ati gūḍha hetu sei tri-vidha prakāra\\ndāmodara-svarūpa haite yāhāra pracāra
verses.translation: That most confidential cause is threefold. Svarūpa Dāmodara has revealed it.

verses.devanagari: স্বরূপ-গোসাঞি — প্রভুর অতি অন্তরঙ্গ ।\\nতাহাতে জানেন প্রভুর এসব প্রসঙ্গ ॥১০৫॥
verses.transliteration: svarūpa-gosāñi—prabhura ati antaraṅga\\ntāhāte jānena prabhura e-saba prasaṅga
verses.translation: Svarūpa Gosāñi is the most intimate associate of the Lord. He, therefore, knows all these topics well.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Prior to the Lord's acceptance of the renounced order, Puruṣottama Bhaṭṭācārya, a resident of Navadvīpa, desired to enter the renounced order of life. Therefore he left home and went to Benares, where he accepted the position of
brahmacarya
from a Māyāvādī
sannyāsī.
When he became a
brahmacārī,
he was given the name Śrī Dāmodara Svarūpa. He left Benares shortly after, without taking
sannyāsa,
and he came to Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, where Lord Caitanya was staying. He met Caitanya Mahāprabhu there and dedicated his life for the service of the Lord. He became Lord Caitanya's secretary and constant companion. He used to enhance the pleasure potency of the Lord by singing appropriate songs, which were very much appreciated. Svarūpa Dāmodara could understand the secret mission of Lord Caitanya, and it was by his grace only that all the devotees of Lord Caitanya could know the real purpose of the Lord.
Svarūpa Dāmodara has been identified as Lalitā-devī, the second expansion of Rādhārāṇī. However, the authoritative
Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā
of Kavi-karṇapūra describes Svarūpa Dāmodara as the same Viśākhā-devī who serves the Lord in Goloka Vṛndāvana. Therefore it is to be understood that Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara is a direct expansion of Rādhārāṇī who helps the Lord experience the attitude of Rādhārāṇī.

verses.devanagari: রাধিকার ভাব-মূর্তি প্রভুর অন্তর ।\\nসেই ভাবে সুখ-দুঃখ উঠে নিরন্তর ॥১০৬॥
verses.transliteration: rādhikāra bhāva-mūrti prabhura antara\\nsei bhāve sukha-duḥkha uṭhe nirantara
verses.translation: The heart of Lord Caitanya is the image of Śrī Rādhikā's emotions. Thus feelings of pleasure and pain arise constantly therein.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Lord Caitanya's heart was full of the feelings of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, and His appearance resembled Hers. Svarūpa Dāmodara has explained His attitude as
rādhā-bhāva-mūrti,
the attitude of Rādhārāṇī. One who engages in sense gratification on the material platform can hardly understand
rādhā-bhāva,
but one who is freed from the demands of sense gratification can understand it.
Rādhā-bhāva
must be understood from the Gosvāmīs, those who are actually controllers of the senses. From such authorized sources it is to be known that the attitude of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the highest perfection of conjugal love, which is the highest of the five transcendental mellows, and it is the complete perfection of love of Kṛṣṇa.
These transcendental affairs can be understood on two platforms. One is called elevated, and the other is called superelevated. The loving affairs exhibited in Dvārakā are the elevated form. The superelevated position is reached in the manifestations of the pastimes of Vṛndāvana. The attitude of Lord Caitanya is certainly superelevated.
From the life of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, an intelligent person engaged in pure devotional service can understand that He always felt separation from Kṛṣṇa within Himself. In that separation He sometimes felt that He had found Kṛṣṇa and was enjoying the meeting. The significance of this separation and meeting is very specific. If someone tries to understand the exalted position of Lord Caitanya without knowing this, he is sure to misunderstand it. One must first become fully self-realized. Otherwise he may misidentify the Lord as
nāgara,
or the enjoyer of the damsels of Vraja, thus committing the mistake of
rasābhāsa,
or overlapping understanding.

verses.devanagari: শেষলীলায় প্রভুর কৃষ্ণবিরহ-উন্মাদ ।\\nভ্রমময় চেষ্টা, আর প্রলাপময় বাদ ॥১০৭॥
verses.transliteration: śeṣa-līlāya prabhura kṛṣṇa-viraha-unmāda\\nbhrama-maya ceṣṭā, āra pralāpa-maya vāda
verses.translation: In the final portion of His pastimes, Lord Caitanya was obsessed with the madness of separation from Lord Kṛṣṇa. He acted in erroneous ways and talked deliriously.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Lord Śrī Caitanya exhibited the highest stage of the feelings of a devotee in separation from the Lord. This exhibition was sublime because He was completely perfect in the feelings of separation. Materialists, however, cannot understand this. Sometimes materialistic scholars think He was diseased or crazy. Their problem is that they always engage in material sense gratification and can never understand the feelings of the devotees and the Lord. Materialists are most abominable in their ideas. They think that they can enjoy directly perceivable gross objects by their senses and that they can similarly deal with the transcendental features of Lord Caitanya. But the Lord is understood only in pursuance of the principles laid down by the Gosvāmīs, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara. Doctrines like those of the
nadīyā-nāgarīs,
a class of so-called devotees, are never presented by authorized persons like Svarūpa Dāmodara or the six Gosvāmīs. The ideas of the
gaurāṅga-nāgarīs
are simply a mental concoction, and they are completely on the mental platform.

verses.devanagari: রাধিকার ভাব যৈছে উদ্ধবদর্শনে ।\\nসেই ভাবে মত্ত প্রভু রহে রাত্রিদিনে ॥১০৮॥
verses.transliteration: rādhikāra bhāva yaiche uddhava-darśane\\nsei bhāve matta prabhu rahe rātri-dine
verses.translation: Just as Rādhikā went mad at the sight of Uddhava, so Lord Caitanya was obsessed day and night with the madness of separation.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Those under the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand that His mode of worship of the Supreme Lord Kṛṣṇa in separation is the real worship of the Lord. When the feelings of separation become very intense, one attains the stage of meeting Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
So-called devotees like the
sahajiyās
cheaply imagine they are meeting Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana. Such thinking may be useful, but actually meeting Kṛṣṇa is possible through the attitude of separation taught by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: রাত্রে প্রলাপ করে স্বরূপের কণ্ঠ ধরি’ ।\\nআবেশে আপন ভাব কহয়ে উঘাড়ি’ ॥১০৯॥
verses.transliteration: rātre pralāpa kare svarūpera kaṇṭha dhari'\\nāveśe āpana bhāva kahaye ughāḍi'
verses.translation: At night He talked incoherently in grief with His arms around Svarūpa Dāmodara's neck. He spoke out His heart in ecstatic inspiration.

verses.devanagari: যবে যেই ভাব উঠে প্রভুর অন্তর ।\\nসেই গীতি-শ্লোকে সুখ দেন দামোদর ॥১১০॥
verses.transliteration: yabe yei bhāva uṭhe prabhura antara\\nsei gīti-śloke sukha dena dāmodara
verses.translation: Whenever a particular sentiment arose in His heart, Svarūpa Dāmodara satisfied Him by singing songs or reciting verses of the same nature.

verses.devanagari: এবে কার্য নাহি কিছু এসব বিচারে ।\\nআগে ইহা বিবরিব করিয়া বিস্তারে ॥১১১॥
verses.transliteration: ebe kārya nāhi kichu e-saba vicāre\\nāge ihā vivariba kariyā vistāre
verses.translation: To analyze these pastimes is not necessary now. Later I shall describe them in detail.

verses.devanagari: পূর্বে ব্রজে কৃষ্ণের ত্রিবিধ বয়োধর্ম ।\\nকৌমার, পৌগণ্ড, আর কৈশোর অতিমর্ম ॥১১২॥
verses.transliteration: pūrve vraje kṛṣṇera tri-vidha vayo-dharma\\nkaumāra, paugaṇḍa, āra kaiśora atimarma
verses.translation: Formerly in Vraja Lord Kṛṣṇa displayed three ages, namely childhood, boyhood and adolescence. His adolescence is especially significant.

verses.devanagari: বাৎসল্য-আবেশে কৈল কৌমার সফল ।\\nপৌগণ্ড সফল কৈল লঞা সখাবল ॥১১৩॥
verses.transliteration: vātsalya-āveśe kaila kaumqāra saphala\\npaugaṇḍa saphala kaila lañā sakhāvala
verses.translation: Parental affection made His childhood fruitful. His boyhood was successful with His friends.

verses.devanagari: রাধিকাদি লঞা কৈল রাসাদি-বিলাস ।\\nবাঞ্ছা ভরি’ আস্বাদিল রসের নির্যাস ॥১১৪॥
verses.transliteration: rādhikādi lañā kaila rāsādi-vilāsa\\nvāñchā bhari' āsvādila rasera niryāsa
verses.translation: In youth He tasted the essence of rasa, fulfilling His desires in pastimes like the rāsa dance with Śrīmatī Rādhikā and the other gopīs.

verses.devanagari: কৈশোর-বয়সে কাম, জগৎসকল ।\\nরাসাদি-লীলায় তিন করিল সফল ॥১১৫॥
verses.transliteration: kaiśora-vayase kāma, jagat-sakala\\nrāsādi-līlāya tina karila saphala
verses.translation: In His youth Lord Kṛṣṇa made all three of His ages, and the entire universe, successful by His pastimes of amorous love like the rāsa dance.

verses.devanagari: সোঽপি কৈশোরক-বয়ো মানয়ন্মধুসূদনঃ ।\\nরেমে স্ত্রীরত্নকূটস্থঃ ক্ষপাসু ক্ষপিতাহিতঃ ॥১১৬॥
verses.transliteration: so 'pi kaiśoraka-vayo\\nmānayan madhusūdanaḥ\\nreme strī-ratna-kūṭa-sthaḥ\\nkṣapāsu kṣapitāhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Lord Madhusūdana enjoyed His youth with pastimes on autumn nights in the midst of the jewellike milkmaids. Thus He dispelled all the misfortunes of the world."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from the
Viṣṇu Purāṇa
(5.13.60).

verses.devanagari: বাচা সূচিতশর্বরীরতিকলাপ্রাগল্ভ্যয়া রাধিকাং\\nব্রীড়াকুঞ্চিতলোচনাং বিরচয়ন্নগ্রে সখীনামসৌ ।\\nতদ্বক্ষোরুহচিত্রকেলিমকরীপাণ্ডিত্যপারং গতঃ\\nকৈশোরং সফলীকরোতি কলয়ন্ কুঞ্জে বিহারং হরিঃ ॥১১৭॥
verses.transliteration: vācā sūcita-śarvarī-rati-kalā-prāgalbhyayā rādhikāṁ\\nvrīḍā-kuñcita-locanāṁ viracayann agre sakhīnām asau\\ntad-vakṣo-ruha-citra-keli-makarī-pāṇḍitya-pāraṁ gataḥ\\nkaiśoraṁ saphalī-karoti kalayan kuñje vihāraṁ hariḥ
verses.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa made Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī close Her eyes in shame before Her friends by His words relating Their amorous activities on the previous night. Then He showed the highest limit of cleverness in drawing pictures of dolphins in various playful sports on Her breasts. In this way Lord Hari made His youth successful by performing pastimes in the bushes with Śrī Rādhā and Her friends."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(2.1.231) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: হরিরেষ ন চেদবাতরিস্যন্মথুরায়াং মধুরাক্ষি রাধিকা চ ।\\nঅভবিষ্যদিয়ং বৃথা বিসৃষ্টি-র্মকরাঙ্কস্তু বিশেষতস্তদাত্র\\nএই মত পূর্বে কৃষ্ণ রসের সদন ।\\nযদ্যপি করিল রস-নির্যাস-চর্বণ\\nতথাপি নহিল তিন বাঞ্ছিত পূরণ ।\\nতাহা আস্বাদিতে যদি করিল যতন ॥১১৮॥
verses.transliteration: harir eṣa na ced avātariṣyan\\nmathurāyāṁ madhurākṣi rādhikā ca\\nabhaviṣyad iyaṁ vṛthā visṛṣṭir\\nmakarāṅkas tu viśeṣatas tadātra
verses.translation: "O Paurṇamāsī, if Lord Hari had not descended in Mathurā with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, this entire creation-and especially Cupid, the demigod of love-would have been useless."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is spoken by Śrī Vṛndā-devī in the
Vidagdha-mādhava
(7.3) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: এই মত পূর্বে কৃষ্ণ রসের সদন ।\\nযদ্যপি করিল রস-নির্যাস-চর্বণ ॥১১৯॥\\nতথাপি নহিল তিন বাঞ্ছিত পূরণ ।\\nতাহা আস্বাদিতে যদি করিল যতন ॥১২০॥
verses.transliteration: tathāpi nahila tina vāñchita pūraṇa\\ntāhā āsvādite yadi karila yatana
verses.translation: Even though Lord Kṛṣṇa, the abode of all mellows, had previously in this way chewed the essence of the mellows of love, still He was unable to fulfill three desires, although He made efforts to taste them.

verses.devanagari: তাঁহার প্রথম বাঞ্ছা করিয়ে ব্যাখ্যান ।\\nকৃষ্ণ কহে, — ‘আমি হই রসের নিদান ॥১২১॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅhāra prathama vāñchā kariye vyākhyāna\\nkṛṣṇa kahe,—'āmi ha-i rasera nidāna
verses.translation: I shall explain His first desire. Kṛṣṇa says, "I am the primary cause of all rasas.

verses.devanagari: পূর্ণানন্দময় আমি চিন্ময় পূর্ণতত্ত্ব ।\\nরাধিকার প্রেমে আমা করায় উন্মত্ত ॥১২২॥
verses.transliteration: pūrṇānanda-maya āmi cin-maya pūrṇa-tattva\\nrādhikāra preme āmā karāya unmatta
verses.translation: "I am the full spiritual truth and am made of full joy, but the love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī drives Me mad.

verses.devanagari: না জানি রাধার প্রেমে আছে কত বল ।\\nযে বলে আমারে করে সর্বদা বিহ্বল ॥১২৩॥
verses.transliteration: nā jāni rādhāra preme āche kata bala\\nye bale āmāre kare sarvadā vihvala
verses.translation: "I do not know the strength of Rādhā's love, with which She always overwhelms Me.

verses.devanagari: রাধিকার প্রেম — গুরু, আমি — শিষ্য নট ।\\nসদা আমা নানা নৃত্যে নাচায় উদ্ভট ॥১২৪॥
verses.transliteration: rādhikāra prema—guru, āmi—śiṣya naṭa\\nsadā āmā nānā nṛtye nācāya udbhaṭa
verses.translation: "The love of Rādhikā is My teacher, and I am Her dancing pupil. Her prema makes Me dance various novel dances."

verses.devanagari: কস্মাদ্বৃন্দে প্রিয়সখি হরেঃ পাদমূলাৎ কুতোঽসৌ\\nকুণ্ডারণ্যে কিমিহ কুরুতে নৃত্যশিক্ষাং গুরুঃ কঃ ।\\nতং ত্বন্মূর্তিঃ প্রতিতরুলতং দিগ্বিদিক্ষু স্ফুরন্তী\\nশৈলূষীব ভ্রমতি পরিতো নর্তয়ন্তী স্ব-পশ্চাৎ ॥১২৫॥
verses.transliteration: kasmād vṛnde priya-sakhi hareḥ pāda-mūlāt kuto 'sau\\nkuṇḍāraṇye kim iha kurute nṛtya-śikṣāṁ guruḥ kaḥ\\ntaṁ tvan-mūrtiḥ prati-taru-lataṁ dig-vidikṣu sphurantī\\nśailūṣīva bhramati parito nartayantī sva-paścāt
verses.translation:
"O my beloved friend Vṛndā, where are you coming from?" \\
"I am coming from the feet of Śrī Hari." \\
"Where is He?" \\
"In the forest on the bank of Rādhā-kuṇḍa." \\
"What is He doing there?" \\
"He is learning dancing." \\
"Who is His master?" \\
"Your image, Rādhā, revealing itself in every tree and creeper in every direction, is roaming like a skillful dancer, making Him dance behind."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text is from the
Govinda-līlāmṛta
(8.77) of Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: নিজ-প্রেমাস্বাদে মোর হয় যে আহ্লাদ ।\\nতাহা হ’তে কোটিগুণ রাধা-প্রেমাস্বাদ ॥১২৬॥
verses.transliteration: nija-premāsvāde mora haya ye āhlāda\\ntāhā ha'te koṭi-guṇa rādhā-premāsvāda
verses.translation: "Whatever pleasure I get from tasting My love for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, She tastes ten million times more than Me by Her love.

verses.devanagari: আমি যৈছে পরস্পর বিরুদ্ধধর্মাশ্রয় ।\\nরাধাপ্রেম তৈছে সদা বিরুদ্ধধর্মময় ॥১২৭॥
verses.transliteration: āmi yaiche paraspara viruddha-dharmāśraya\\nrādhā-prema taiche sadā viruddha-dharma-maya
verses.translation: "Just as I am the abode of all mutually contradictory characteristics, so Rādhā's love is always full of similar contradictions.

verses.devanagari: রাধা-প্রেমা বিভু — যার বাড়িতে নাহি ঠাঞি ।\\nতথাপি সে ক্ষণে ক্ষণে বাড়য়ে সদাই ॥১২৮॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-premā vibhu—yāra bāḍite nāhi ṭhāñi\\ntathāpi se kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍaye sadāi
verses.translation: "Rādhā's love is all-pervading, leaving no room for expansion. But still it is expanding constantly.

verses.devanagari: যাহা বই গুরু বস্তু নাহি সুনিশ্চিত ।\\nতথাপি গুরুর ধর্ম গৌরব-বর্জিত ॥১২৯॥
verses.transliteration: yāhā va-i guru vastu nāhi suniścita\\ntathāpi gurura dharma gaurava-varjita
verses.translation: "There is certainly nothing greater than Her love. But Her love is devoid of pride. That is the sign of its greatness.

verses.devanagari: যাহা হৈতে সুনির্মল দ্বিতীয় নাহি আর ।\\nতথাপি সর্বদা বাম্য-বক্র-ব্যবহার ॥১৩০॥
verses.transliteration: yāhā haite sunirmala dvitīya nāhi āra\\ntathāpi sarvadā vāmya-vakra-vyavahāra
verses.translation: "Nothing is purer than Her love. But its behavior is always perverse and crooked."

verses.devanagari: বিভুরপি কলয়ন্ সদাভিবৃদ্ধিং\\nগুরুরপি গৌরবচর্যয়া বিহীনঃ ।\\nমুহুরুপচিতবক্রিমাপি শুদ্ধো\\nজয়তি মুরদ্বিষি রাধিকানুরাগঃ ॥১৩১॥
verses.transliteration: vibhur api kalayan sadābhivṛddhiṁ\\ngurur api gaurava-caryayā vihīnaḥ\\nmuhur upacita-vakrimāpi śuddho\\njayati mura-dviṣi rādhikānurāgaḥ
verses.translation: "All glories to Rādhā's love for Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of the demon Mura. Although it is all-pervading, it tends to increase at every moment. Although it is important, it is devoid of pride. And although it is pure, it is always beset with duplicity."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from the
Dāna-keli-kaumudī
(2) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: সেই প্রেমার শ্রীরাধিকা পরম ‘আশ্রয়’ ।\\nসেই প্রেমার আমি হই কেবল ‘বিষয়’ ॥১৩২॥
verses.transliteration: sei premāra śrī-rādhikā parama 'āśraya'\\nsei premāra āmi ha-i kevala 'viṣaya'
verses.translation: "Śrī Rādhikā is the highest abode of that love, and I am its only object.

verses.devanagari: বিষয়জাতীয় সুখ আমার আস্বাদ ।\\nআমা হৈতে কোটিগুণ আশ্রয়ের আহ্লাদ ॥১৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: viṣaya-jātīya sukha āmāra āsvāda\\nāmā haite koṭi-guṇa āśrayera āhlāda
verses.translation: "I taste the bliss to which the object of love is entitled. But the pleasure of Rādhā, the abode of that love, is ten million times greater.

verses.devanagari: আশ্রয়জাতীয় সুখ পাইতে মন ধায় ।\\nযত্নে আস্বাদিতে নারি, কি করি উপায় ॥১৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: āśraya-jātiya sukha pāite mana dhāya\\nyatne āsvādite nāri, ki kari upāya
verses.translation: "My mind races to taste the pleasure experienced by the abode, but I cannot taste it, even by My best efforts. How may I taste it?

verses.devanagari: কভু যদি এই প্রেমার হইয়ে আশ্রয় ।\\nতবে এই প্রেমানন্দের অনুভব হয় ॥১৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: kabhu yadi ei premāra ha-iye āśraya\\ntabe ei premānandera anubhava haya
verses.translation: "If sometime I can be the abode of that love, only then may I taste its joy."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Viṣaya
and
āśraya
are two very significant words relating to the reciprocation between Kṛṣṇa and His devotee. The devotee is called the
āśraya,
and his beloved, Kṛṣṇa, is the
viṣaya.
Different ingredients are involved in the exchange of love between the
āśraya
and
viṣaya,
which are known as
vibhāva, anubhāva, sāttvika
and
vyabhicārī. Vibhāva
is divided into the two categories
ālambana
and
uddīpana. Ālambana
may be further divided into
āśraya
and
viṣaya.
In the loving affairs of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, Rādhārāṇī is the
āśraya
feature and Kṛṣṇa the
viṣaya.
The transcendental consciousness of the Lord tells Him, "I am Kṛṣṇa, and I experience pleasure as the
viṣaya.
The pleasure enjoyed by Rādhārāṇī, the
āśraya,
is many times greater than the pleasure I feel." Therefore, to feel the pleasure of the
āśraya
category, Lord Kṛṣṇa appeared as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: এত চিন্তি’ রহে কৃষ্ণ পরমকৌতুকী ।\\nহৃদয়ে বাড়য়ে প্রেম-লোভ ধক্ধকি ॥১৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: eta cinti' rahe kṛṣṇa parama-kautukī\\nhṛdaye bāḍaye prema-lobha dhakdhaki
verses.translation: Thinking in this way, Lord Kṛṣṇa was curious to taste that love. His eager desire for that love increasingly blazed in His heart.

verses.devanagari: এই এক, শুন আর লোভের প্রকার ।\\nস্বমাধুর্য দেখি’ কৃষ্ণ করেন বিচার ॥১৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: ei eka, śuna āra lobhera prakāra\\nsva-mādhurya dekhi' kṛṣṇa karena vicāra
verses.translation: That is one desire. Now please hear of another. Seeing His own beauty, Lord Kṛṣṇa began to consider.

verses.devanagari: অদ্ভুত, অনন্ত, পূর্ণ মোর মধুরিমা ।\\nত্রিজগতে ইহার কেহ নাহি পায় সীমা ॥১৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: adbhuta, ananta, pūrṇa mora madhurimā\\ntri-jagate ihāra keha nāhi pāya sīmā
verses.translation: "My sweetness is wonderful, infinite and full. No one in the three worlds can find its limit.

verses.devanagari: এই প্রেমদ্বারে নিত্য রাধিকা একলি ।\\nআমার মাধুর্যামৃত আস্বাদে সকলি ॥১৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei prema-dvāre nitya rādhikā ekali\\nāmāra mādhuryāmṛta āsvāde sakali
verses.translation: "Only Rādhikā, by the strength of Her love, tastes all the nectar of My sweetness.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি নির্মল রাধার সৎপ্রেমদর্পণ ।\\nতথাপি স্বচ্ছতা তার বাঢ়ে ক্ষণে ক্ষণ ॥১৪০॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi nirmala rādhāra sat-prema-darpaṇa\\ntathāpi svacchatā tāra bāḍhe kṣaṇe kṣaṇa
verses.translation: "Although Rādhā's love is pure like a mirror, its purity increases at every moment.

verses.devanagari: আমার মাধুর্য নাহি বাঢ়িতে অবকাশে ।\\nএ-দর্পণের আগে নব নব রূপে ভাসে ॥১৪১॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra mādhurya nāhi bāḍhite avakāśe\\ne-darpaṇera āge nava nava rūpe bhāse
verses.translation: "My sweetness also has no room for expansion, yet it shines before that mirror in newer and newer beauty.

verses.devanagari: মন্মাধুর্য রাধার প্রেম — দোঁহে হোড় করি’ ।\\nক্ষণে ক্ষণে বাড়ে দোঁহে, কেহ নাহি হারি ॥১৪২॥
verses.transliteration: man-mādhurya rādhāra prema—doṅhe hoḍa kari'\\nkṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍe doṅhe, keha nāhi hāri
verses.translation: "There is constant competition between My sweetness and the mirror of Rādhā's love. They both go on increasing, but neither knows defeat.

verses.devanagari: আমার মাধুর্য নিত্য নব নব হয় ।\\nস্ব-স্ব-প্রেম-অনুরূপ ভক্তে আস্বাদয় ॥১৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra mādhurya nitya nava nava haya\\nsva-sva-prema-anurūpa bhakte āsvādaya
verses.translation: "My sweetness is always newer and newer. Devotees taste it according to their own respective love.

verses.devanagari: দর্পণাদ্যে দেখি’ যদি আপন মাধুরী ।\\nআস্বাদিতে হয় লোভ, আস্বাদিতে নারি ॥১৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: darpaṇādye dekhi' yadi āpana mādhurī\\nāsvādite haya lobha, āsvādite nāri
verses.translation: "If I see My sweetness in a mirror, I am tempted to taste it, but nevertheless I cannot.

verses.devanagari: বিচার করিয়ে যদি আস্বাদ-উপায় ।\\nরাধিকাস্বরূপ হইতে তবে মন ধায় ॥১৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: vicāra kariye yadi āsvāda-upāya\\nrādhikā-svarūpa ha-ite tabe mana dhāya
verses.translation: "If I deliberate on a way to taste it, I find that I hanker for the position of Rādhikā."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Kṛṣṇa's attractiveness is wonderful and unlimited. No one can know the end of it. Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī alone can relish such extensiveness from Her position in the
āśraya
category. The mirror of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's transcendental love is perfectly clear, yet it appears clearer and clearest in the transcendental method of understanding Kṛṣṇa. In the mirror of Rādhārāṇī's heart, the transcendental features of Kṛṣṇa appear increasingly new and fresh. In other words, the attraction of Kṛṣṇa increases in proportion to the understanding of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Each tries to supersede the other. Neither wants to be defeated in increasing the intensity of love. Desiring to understand Rādhārāṇī's attitude of increasing love, Lord Kṛṣṇa appeared as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: অপরিকলিতপূর্বঃ কশ্চমৎকারকারী\\nস্ফুরতি মম গরীয়ানেষ মাধুর্যপূরঃ ।\\nঅয়মহমপি হন্ত প্রেক্ষ্য যং লুব্ধচেতাঃ\\nসরভসমুপভোক্তুং কাময়ে রাধিকেব ॥১৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: aparikalita-pūrvaḥ kaś camatkāra-kārī\\nsphurati mama garīyān eṣa mādhurya-pūraḥ\\nayam aham api hanta prekṣya yaṁ lubdha-cetāḥ\\nsarabhasam upabhoktuṁ kāmaye rādhikeva
verses.translation: "Who manifests an abundance of sweetness greater than Mine, which has never been experienced before and which causes wonder to all? Alas, I Myself, My mind bewildered upon seeing this beauty, impetuously desire to enjoy it like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text is from the
Lalita-mādhava
(8.34) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. It was spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa when He saw the beauty of His own reflection in a jeweled fountain in Dvārakā.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণমাধুর্যের এক স্বাভাবিক বল ।\\nকৃষ্ণআদি নরনারী করয়ে চঞ্চল ॥১৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa-mādhuryera eka svābhāvika bala\\nkṛṣṇa-ādi nara-nārī karaye cañcala
verses.translation: The beauty of Kṛṣṇa has one natural strength: it thrills the hearts of all men and women, beginning with Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.

verses.devanagari: শ্রবণে, দর্শনে আকর্ষয়ে সর্বমন ।\\nআপনা আস্বাদিতে কৃষ্ণ করেন যতন ॥১৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: śravaṇe, darśane ākarṣaye sarva-mana\\nāpanā āsvādite kṛṣṇa karena yatana
verses.translation: All minds are attracted by hearing His sweet voice and flute, or by seeing His beauty. Even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself makes efforts to taste that sweetness.

verses.devanagari: এ মাধুর্যামৃত পান সদা যেই করে ।\\nতৃষ্ণাশান্তি নহে, তৃষ্ণা বাঢ়ে নিরন্তরে ॥১৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: e mādhuryāmṛta pāna sadā yei kare\\ntṛṣṇā-śānti nahe, tṛṣṇā bāḍhe nirantare
verses.translation: The thirst of one who always drinks the nectar of that sweetness is never satisfied. Rather, that thirst increases constantly.

verses.devanagari: অতৃপ্ত হইয়া করে বিধির নিন্দন ।\\nঅবিদগ্ধ বিধি ভাল না জানে সৃজন ॥১৫০॥
verses.transliteration: atṛpta ha-iyā kare vidhira nindana\\navidagdha vidhi bhāla nā jāne sṛjana
verses.translation: Such a person, being unsatisfied, begins to blaspheme Lord Brahmā, saying that he does not know the art of creating well and is simply inexperienced.

verses.devanagari: কোটি নেত্র নাহি দিল, সবে দিল দুই ।\\nতাহাতে নিমেষ, — কৃষ্ণ কি দেখিব মুঞি ॥১৫১॥
verses.transliteration: koṭi netra nāhi dila, sabe dila dui\\ntāhāte nimeṣa,—kṛṣṇa ki dekhiba muñi
verses.translation: He has not given millions of eyes to see the beauty of Kṛṣṇa. He has given only two eyes, and even those eyes blink. How then shall I see the lovely face of Kṛṣṇa?

verses.devanagari: অটতি যদ্ভবানহ্নি কাননং,\\nত্রুটির্যুগায়তে ত্বামপশ্যতাম্ ।\\nকুটিলকুন্তলং শ্রীমুখঞ্চ তে,\\nজড় উদীক্ষতাং পক্ষ্মকৃদ্দৃশাম্ ॥১৫২॥
verses.transliteration: aṭati yad bhavān ahni kānanaṁ\\ntruṭir yugāyate tvām apaśyatām\\nkuṭila-kuntalaṁ śrī-mukhaṁ ca te\\njaḍa udīkṣatāṁ pakṣma-kṛd dṛśām
verses.translation: [The gopīs say:] "O Kṛṣṇa, when You go to the forest during the day and we do not see Your sweet face, which is surrounded by beautiful curling hair, half a second becomes as long as an entire age for us. And we consider the creator, who has put eyelids on the eyes we use for seeing You, to be simply a fool."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is spoken by the
gopīs
in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.31.15).

verses.devanagari: গোপ্যশ্চ কৃষ্ণমুপলভ্য চিরাদভীষ্টং\\nযৎপ্রেক্ষণে দৃশিষু পক্ষ্মকৃতং শপন্তি ।\\nদৃগ্ভির্হৃদীকৃতমলং পরিরভ্য সর্বা-\\nস্তদ্ভাবমাপুরপি নিত্যযুজাং দুরাপম্ ॥১৫৩॥
verses.transliteration: gopyaś ca kṛṣṇam upalabhya cirād abhīṣṭaṁ\\nyat-prekṣaṇe dṛśiṣu pakṣma-kṛtaṁ śapanti\\ndṛgbhir hṛdi kṛtam alaṁ parirabhya sarvās\\ntad-bhāvam āpur api nitya-yujāṁ durāpam
verses.translation: "The gopīs saw their beloved Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra after a long separation. They secured and embraced Him in their hearts through their eyes, and they attained a joy so intense that not even perfect yogīs can attain it. The gopīs cursed the creator for creating eyelids that interfered with their vision."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text is from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.82.39).

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণাবলোকন বিনা নেত্র ফল নাহি আন ।\\nযেই জন কৃষ্ণ দেখে, সেই ভাগ্যবান্ ॥১৫৪॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāvalokana vinā netra phala nāhi āna\\nyei jana kṛṣṇa dekhe, sei bhāgyavān
verses.translation: There is no other consummation for the eyes than the sight of Kṛṣṇa. Whoever sees Him is most fortunate indeed.

verses.devanagari: অক্ষণ্বতাং ফলমিদং ন পরং বিদামঃ\\nসখ্যঃ পশূননুবিবেশয়তোর্বয়স্যৈঃ ।\\nবক্ত্রং ব্রজেশসুতয়োরনুবেণুজুষ্টং\\nযৈর্বা নিপীতমনুরক্তকটাক্ষমোক্ষম্ ॥১৫৫॥
verses.transliteration: akṣaṇvatāṁ phalam idaṁ na paraṁ vidāmaḥ\\nsakhyaḥ paśūn anuviveśayator vayasyaiḥ\\nvaktraṁ vrajeśa-sutayor anuveṇu-juṣṭaṁ\\nyair vā nipītam anurakta-kaṭākṣa-mokṣam
verses.translation: [The gopīs say:] "O friends, those eyes that see the beautiful faces of the sons of Mahārāja Nanda are certainly fortunate. As these two sons enter the forest, surrounded by Their friends, driving the cows before Them, They hold Their flutes to Their mouths and glance lovingly upon the residents of Vṛndāvana. For those who have eyes, we think there is no greater object of vision."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Like the
gopīs,
one can see Kṛṣṇa continuously if one is fortunate enough. In the
Brahma-saṁhitā
it is said that sages whose eyes have been smeared with the ointment of pure love can see the form of Śyāmasundara (Kṛṣṇa) continuously in the centers of their hearts. This text from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.21.7) was sung by the
gopīs
on the advent of the
śarat
season.

verses.devanagari: গোপ্যস্তপঃ কিমচরন্ যদমুষ্য রূপং\\nলাবণ্যসারমসমোর্ধ্বমনন্যসিদ্ধম্ ।\\nদৃগ্ভিঃ পিবন্ত্যনুসবাভিনবং দুরাপ-\\nমেকান্তধাম যশসঃ শ্রিয় ঐশ্বরস্য ॥১৫৬॥
verses.transliteration: gopyas tapaḥ kim acaran yad amuṣya rūpaṁ\\nlāvaṇya-sāram asamordhvam ananya-siddham\\ndṛgbhiḥ pibanty anusavābhinavaṁ durāpam\\nekānta-dhāma yaśasaḥ śriya aiśvarasya
verses.translation: [The women of Mathurā say:] "What austerities must the gopīs have performed? With their eyes they always drink the nectar of the face of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is the essence of loveliness and is not to be equaled or surpassed. That loveliness is the only abode of beauty, fame and opulence. It is self-perfect, ever fresh and extremely rare."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.44.14) was spoken by the women of Mathurā when they saw Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma in the arena with King Kaṁsa's great wrestlers Muṣṭika and Cāṇūra.

verses.devanagari: অপূর্ব মাধুরী কৃষ্ণের, অপূর্ব তার বল ।\\nযাহার শ্রবণে মন হয় টলমল ॥১৫৭॥
verses.transliteration: apūrva mādhurī kṛṣṇera, apūrva tāra bala\\nyāhāra śravaṇe mana haya ṭalamala
verses.translation: The sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa is unprecedented, and its strength is also unprecedented. Simply by hearing of such beauty, the mind becomes unsteady.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের মাধুর্যে কৃষ্ণে উপজয় লোভ ।\\nসম্যক্ আস্বাদিতে নারে, মনে রহে ক্ষোভ ॥১৫৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera mādhurye kṛṣṇe upajaya lobha\\nsamyak āsvādite nāre, mane rahe kṣobha
verses.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa's own beauty attracts Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself. But because He cannot fully enjoy it, His mind remains full of sorrow.

verses.devanagari: এই ত’ দ্বিতীয় হেতুর কহিল বিবরণ ।\\nতৃতীয় হেতুর এবে শুনহ লক্ষণ ॥১৫৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei ta' dvitīya hetura kahila vivaraṇa\\ntṛtīya hetura ebe śunaha lakṣaṇa
verses.translation: This is a description of His second desire. Now please listen as I describe the third.

verses.devanagari: অত্যন্তনিগূঢ় এই রসের সিদ্ধান্ত ।\\nস্বরূপগোসাঞি মাত্র জানেন একান্ত ॥১৬০॥
verses.transliteration: atyanta-nigūḍha ei rasera siddhānta\\nsvarūpa-gosāñi mātra jānena ekānta
verses.translation: This conclusion of rasa is extremely deep. Only Svarūpa Dāmodara knows much about it.

verses.devanagari: যেবা কেহ অন্য জানে, সেহো তাঁহা হৈতে ।\\nচৈতন্যগোসাঞির তেঁহ অত্যন্ত মর্ম যাতে ॥১৬১॥
verses.transliteration: yebā keha anya jāne, seho tāṅhā haite\\ncaitanya-gosāñira teṅha atyanta marma yāte
verses.translation: Anyone else who claims to know it must have heard it from him, for he was the most intimate companion of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: গোপীগণের প্রেমের ‘রূঢ়ভাব’ নাম ।\\nবিশুদ্ধ নির্মল প্রেম, কভু নহে কাম ॥১৬২॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-gaṇera premera 'rūḍha-bhāva' nāma\\nviśuddha nirmala prema, kabhu nahe kāma
verses.translation: The love of the gopīs is called rūḍha-bhāva. It is pure and spotless. It is not at any time lust.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As already explained, the position of the
gopīs
in their loving dealings with Kṛṣṇa is transcendental. Their emotion is called
rūḍha-bhāva.
Although it is apparently like mundane sex, one should not confuse it with mundane sexual love, for it is pure and unadulterated love of Godhead.

verses.devanagari: ‘প্রেমৈব গোপরামাণাং কাম ইত্যগমৎ প্রথাম্ ।’\\nইত্যুদ্ধবাদয়োঽপ্যেতং বাঞ্ছন্তি ভগবৎপ্রিয়াঃ ॥১৬৩॥
verses.transliteration: premaiva gopa-rāmānāṁ\\nkāma ity agamat prathām\\nity uddhavādayo 'py etaṁ\\nvāñchanti bhagavat-priyāḥ
verses.translation: "The pure love of the gopīs has become celebrated by the name 'lust.' The dear devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrī Uddhava, desire to taste that love."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(1.2.285).

verses.devanagari: কাম, প্রেম, — দোঁহাকার বিভিন্ন লক্ষণ ।\\nলৌহ আর হেম যৈছে স্বরূপে বিলক্ষণ ॥১৬৪॥
verses.transliteration: kāma, prema,—doṅhākāra vibhinna lakṣaṇa\\nlauha āra hema yaiche svarūpe vilakṣaṇa
verses.translation: Lust and love have different characteristics, just as iron and gold have different natures.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nOne should try to discriminate between sexual love and pure love, for they belong to different categories, with a gulf of difference between them. They are as different from one another as iron is from gold.

verses.devanagari: আত্মেন্দ্রিয়প্রীতি-বাঞ্ছা — তারে বলি, ‘কাম’ ।\\nকৃষ্ণেন্দ্রিয়প্রীতি-ইচ্ছা ধরে ‘প্রেম’ নাম ॥১৬৫॥
verses.transliteration: ātmendriya-prīti-vāñchā—tāre bali 'kāma'\\nkṛṣṇendriya-prīti-icchā dhare 'prema' nāma
verses.translation: The desire to gratify one's own senses is kāma [lust], but the desire to please the senses of Lord Kṛṣṇa is prema [love].
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The revealed scriptures describe pure love as follows:
sarvathā dhvaṁsa-rahitaṁ
saty api dhvaṁsa-kāraṇe
yad bhāva-bandhanaṁ yūnoḥ
sa premā parikīrtitaḥ
"If there is ample reason for the dissolution of a conjugal relationship and yet such a dissolution does not take place, such a relationship of intimate love is called pure."
The predominated
gopīs
were bound to Kṛṣṇa in such pure love. For them there was no question of sexual love based on sense gratification. Their only engagement in life was to see Kṛṣṇa happy in all respects, regardless of their own personal interests. They dedicated their souls only for the satisfaction of the Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. There was not the slightest tinge of sexual love between the
gopīs
and Kṛṣṇa.
The author of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta
asserts with authority that sexual love is a matter of personal sense enjoyment. All the regulative principles in the
Vedas
pertaining to desires for popularity, fatherhood, wealth and so on are different phases of sense gratification. Acts of sense gratification may be performed under the cover of public welfare, nationalism, religion, altruism, ethical codes, Biblical codes, health directives, fruitive action, bashfulness, tolerance, personal comfort, liberation from material bondage, progress, family affection or fear of social ostracism or legal punishment, but all these categories are different subdivisions of one substance-sense gratification. All such good acts are performed basically for one's own sense gratification, for no one can sacrifice his personal interest while discharging these much-advertised moral and religious principles. But above all this is a transcendental stage in which one feels himself to be only an eternal servitor of Kṛṣṇa, the absolute Personality of Godhead. All acts performed in this sense of servitude are called pure love of God because they are performed for the absolute sense gratification of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. However, any act performed for the purpose of enjoying its fruits or results is an act of sense gratification. Such actions are visible sometimes in gross and sometimes in subtle forms.

verses.devanagari: কামের তাৎপর্য — নিজসম্ভোগ কেবল ।\\nকৃষ্ণসুখতাৎপর্য-মাত্র প্রেম ত’ প্রবল ॥১৬৬॥
verses.transliteration: kāmera tātparya—nija-sambhoga kevala\\nkṛṣṇa-sukha-tātparya-mātra prema ta' prabala
verses.translation: The object of lust is only the enjoyment of one's own senses. But love caters to the enjoyment of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and thus it is very powerful.

verses.devanagari: লোকধর্ম, বেদধর্ম, দেহধর্ম, কর্ম ।\\nলজ্জা, ধৈর্য, দেহসুখ, আত্মসুখ-মর্ম ॥১৬৭॥\\nদুস্ত্যজ আর্যপথ, নিজ পরিজন ।\\nস্বজনে করয়ে যত তাড়ন-ভর্ৎসন ॥১৬৮॥\\nসর্বত্যাগ করি’ করে কৃষ্ণের ভজন ।\\nকৃষ্ণসুখহেতু করে প্রেম-সেবন ॥১৬৯॥
verses.transliteration: sarva-tyāga kari' kare kṛṣṇera bhajana\\nkṛṣṇa-sukha-hetu kare prema-sevana
verses.translation: Social customs, scriptural injunctions, bodily demands, fruitive action, shyness, patience, bodily pleasures, self-gratification and the path of varṇāśrama-dharma, which is difficult to give up—the gopīs have forsaken all these, as well as their own relatives and their punishment and scolding, for the sake of serving Lord Kṛṣṇa. They render loving service to Him for the sake of His enjoyment.

verses.devanagari: ইহাকে কহিয়ে কৃষ্ণে দৃঢ় অনুরাগ ।\\nস্বচ্ছ ধৌতবস্ত্রে যৈছে নাহি কোন দাগ ॥১৭০॥
verses.transliteration: ihāke kahiye kṛṣṇe dṛḍha anurāga\\nsvaccha dhauta-vastre yaiche nāhi kona dāga
verses.translation: That is called firm attachment to Lord Kṛṣṇa. It is spotlessly pure, like a clean cloth that has no stain.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The author of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta
advises everyone to give up all engagements of sense gratification and, like the
gopīs,
dovetail oneself entirely with the will of the Supreme Lord. That is the ultimate instruction of Kṛṣṇa in
Bhagavad-gītā.
We should be prepared to do anything and everything to please the Lord, even at the risk of violating the Vedic principles or ethical laws. That is the standard of love of Godhead. Such activities in pure love of Godhead are as spotless as white linen that has been completely washed. Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura warns us in this connection that we should not mistakenly think that the idea of giving up everything implies the renunciation of duties necessary in relation to the body and mind. Even such duties are not sense gratification if they are undertaken in a spirit of service to Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: অতএব কাম-প্রেমে বহুত অন্তর ।\\nকাম — অন্ধতমঃ, প্রেম — নির্মল ভাস্কর ॥১৭১॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva kāma-preme bahuta antara\\nkāma—andha-tamaḥ, prema—nirmala bhāskara
verses.translation: Therefore lust and love are quite different. Lust is like dense darkness, but love is like the bright sun.

verses.devanagari: অতএব গোপীগণের নাহি কামগন্ধ ।\\nকৃষ্ণসুখ লাগি মাত্র, কৃষ্ণ সে সম্বন্ধ ॥১৭২॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva gopī-gaṇera nāhi kāma-gandha\\nkṛṣṇa-sukha lāgi mātra, kṛṣṇa se sambandha
verses.translation: Thus there is not the slightest taint of lust in the gopīs' love. Their relationship with Kṛṣṇa is only for the sake of His enjoyment.

verses.devanagari: যত্তে সুজাতচরণাম্বুরুহং স্তনেষু\\nভীতাঃ শনৈঃ প্রিয় দধীমহি কর্কশেষু ।\\nতেনাটবীমটসি তদ্ব্যথতে ন কিং স্বিৎ\\nকূর্পাদিভির্ভ্রমতি ধীর্ভবদায়ুষাং নঃ ॥১৭৩॥
verses.transliteration: yat te sujāta-caraṇāmburuhaṁ staneṣu\\nbhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu\\ntenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit\\nkūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavad-āyuṣāṁ naḥ
verses.translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our life rests only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.31.19) was spoken by the
gopīs
when Kṛṣṇa left them in the midst of the
rāsa-līlā.

verses.devanagari: আত্ম-সুখ-দুঃখে গোপীর নাহিক বিচার ।\\nকৃষ্ণসুখহেতু চেষ্টা মনোব্যবহার ॥১৭৪॥
verses.transliteration: ātma-sukha-duḥkhe gopīra nāhika vicāra\\nkṛṣṇa-sukha-hetu ceṣṭā mano-vyavahāra
verses.translation: The gopīs do not care for their own pleasures or pains. All their physical and mental activities are directed toward offering enjoyment to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণ লাগি’ আর সব করে পরিত্যাগ ।\\nকৃষ্ণসুখহেতু করে শুদ্ধ অনুরাগ ॥১৭৫॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇa lāgi' āra saba kare parityāga\\nkṛṣṇa-sukha-hetu kare śuddha anurāga
verses.translation: They renounced everything for Kṛṣṇa. They have pure attachment to giving Kṛṣṇa pleasure.

verses.devanagari: এবং মদর্থোজ্ঝিতলোকবেদ-\\nস্বানাং হি বো ময্যনুবৃত্তয়েঽবলাঃ ।\\nময়া পরোক্ষং ভজতা তিরোহিতং\\nমাসূয়িতুং মার্হথ তৎ প্রিয়ং প্রিয়াঃ ॥১৭৬॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ mad-arthojjhita-loka-veda-\\nsvānāṁ hi vo mayy anuvṛttaye 'balāḥ\\nmayā parokṣaṁ bhajatā tirohitaṁ\\nmāsūyituṁ mārhatha tat priyaṁ priyāḥ
verses.translation: "O My beloved gopīs, you have renounced social customs, scriptural injunctions and your relatives for My sake. I disappeared behind you only to increase your concentration upon Me. Since I disappeared for your benefit, you should not be displeased with Me."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This text from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.32.21) was spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa when He returned to the arena of the
rāsa-līlā.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের প্রতিজ্ঞা এক আছে পূর্ব হৈতে  ।\\nযে যৈছে ভজে, কৃষ্ণ তারে ভজে তৈছে ॥১৭৭॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera pratijñā eka āche pūrva haite\\nye yaiche bhaje, kṛṣṇa tāre bhaje taiche
verses.translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa has a promise from before to reciprocate with His devotees according to the way they worship Him.

verses.devanagari: যে যথা মাং প্রপদ্যন্তে তাংস্তথৈব ভজাম্যহম্ ।\\nমম বর্ত্মানুবর্তন্তে মনুষ্যাঃ পার্থ সর্বশঃ ॥১৭৮॥
verses.transliteration: ye yathā māṁ prapadyante\\ntāṁs tathaiva bhajāmy aham\\nmama vartmānuvartante\\nmanuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Kṛṣṇa was never ungrateful to the
gopīs,
for as He declares to Arjuna in this verse from
Bhagavad-gītā
(Bg. 4.11), He reciprocates with His devotees in proportion to the transcendental loving service they render unto Him. Everyone follows the path that leads toward Him, but there are different degrees of progress on that path, and the Lord is realized in proportion to one's advancement. The path is one, but the progress in approaching the ultimate goal is different, and therefore the proportion of realization of this goal-namely the absolute Personality of Godhead-is also different. The
gopīs
attained the highest goal, and Lord Caitanya affirmed that there is no higher method of worshiping God than that followed by the
gopīs.

verses.devanagari: সে প্রতিজ্ঞা ভঙ্গ হৈল গোপীর ভজনে ।\\nতাহাতে প্রমাণ কৃষ্ণ-শ্রীমুখবচনে ॥১৭৯॥
verses.transliteration: se pratijñā bhaṅga haila gopīra bhajane\\ntāhāte pramāṇa kṛṣṇa-śrī-mukha-vacane
verses.translation: That promise has been broken by the worship of the gopīs, as Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself admits.

verses.devanagari: ন পারয়েঽহং নিরবদ্যসংযুজাং\\nস্বসাধুকৃত্যং বিবুধায়ুষাপি বঃ ।\\nযা মাঽভজন্ দুর্জয়গেহশৃঙ্খলাঃ\\nসংবৃশ্চ্য তদ্বঃ প্রতিযাতু সাধুনা ॥১৮০॥
verses.transliteration: na pāraye 'haṁ niravadya-saṁyujāṁ\\nsva-sādhu-kṛtyaṁ vibudhāyuṣāpi vaḥ\\nyā mābhajan durjaya-geha-śṛṅkhalāḥ\\nsaṁvṛścya tad vaḥ pratiyātu sādhunā
verses.translation: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(10.32.22) was spoken by Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself when He returned to the
gopīs
upon hearing their songs of separation.

verses.devanagari: তবে যে দেখিয়ে গোপীর নিজদেহে প্রীত ।\\nসেহো ত’ কৃষ্ণের লাগি, জানিহ নিশ্চিত ॥১৮১॥
verses.transliteration: tabe ye dekhiye gopīra nija-dehe prīta\\nseho ta' kṛṣṇera lāgi, jāniha niścita
verses.translation: Now, whatever affection we see the gopīs show in their own bodies, know it for certain to be only for the sake of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The selfless love of Godhead exhibited by the
gopīs
cannot have any parallel. We should not, therefore, misunderstand the carefulness of the
gopīs
in their personal decoration. The
gopīs
dressed themselves as beautifully as possible, just to make Kṛṣṇa happy by seeing them. They had no ulterior desires. They dedicated their bodies, and everything they possessed, to the service of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, taking for granted that their bodies were meant for His enjoyment. They dressed themselves on the understanding that Kṛṣṇa would be happy by seeing and touching them.

verses.devanagari: ‘এই দেহ কৈলুঁ আমি কৃষ্ণে সমর্পণ ।\\nতাঁর ধন তাঁর ইহা সম্ভোগ-সাধন ॥১৮২॥
verses.transliteration: 'ei deha kailuṅ āmi kṛṣṇe samarpaṇa\\ntāṅra dhana tāṅra ihā sambhoga-sādhana
verses.translation: [The gopīs think:] "I have offered this body to Lord Kṛṣṇa. He is its owner, and it brings Him enjoyment.

verses.devanagari: এদেহ-দর্শন-স্পর্শে কৃষ্ণ-সন্তোষণ’ ।\\nএই লাগি’ করে দেহের মার্জন-ভূষণ ॥১৮৩॥
verses.transliteration: e-deha-darśana-sparśe kṛṣṇa-santoṣaṇa'\\nei lāgi' kare dehera mārjana-bhūsaṇa
verses.translation: "Kṛṣṇa finds joy in seeing and touching this body." It is for this reason that they cleanse and decorate their bodies.

verses.devanagari: নিজাঙ্গমপি যা গোপ্যো মমেতি সমুপাসতে ।\\nতাভ্যঃ পরং ন মে পার্থ নিগূঢ়প্রেমভাজনম্ ॥১৮৪॥
verses.transliteration: nijāṅgam api yā gopyo\\nmameti samupāsate\\ntābhyaḥ paraṁ na me pārtha\\nnigūḍha-prema-bhājanam
verses.translation: "O Arjuna, there are no greater receptacles of deep love for Me than the gopīs, who cleanse and decorate their bodies because they consider them Mine."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis verse is spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the\nĀdi Purāṇa.

verses.devanagari: আর এক অদ্ভুত গোপীভাবের স্বভাব ।\\nবুদ্ধির গোচর নহে যাহার প্রভাব ॥১৮৫॥
verses.transliteration: āra eka adbhuta gopī-bhāvera svabhāva\\nbuddhira gocara nahe yāhāra prabhāva
verses.translation: There is another wonderful feature of the emotion of the gopīs. Its power is beyond the comprehension of the intelligence.

verses.devanagari: গোপীগণ করে যবে কৃষ্ণ-দরশন ।\\nসুখবাঞ্ছা নাহি, সুখ হয় কোটিগুণ ॥১৮৬॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-gaṇa kare yabe kṛṣṇa-daraśana\\nsukha-vāñchā nāhi, sukha haya koṭi-guṇa
verses.translation: When the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa, they derive unbounded bliss, although they have no desire for such pleasure.

verses.devanagari: গোপিকা-দর্শনে কৃষ্ণের যে আনন্দ হয় ।\\nতাহা হৈতে কোটিগুণ গোপী আস্বাদয় ॥১৮৭॥
verses.transliteration: gopīkā-darśane kṛṣṇera ye ānanda haya\\ntāhā haite koṭi-guṇa gopī āsvādaya
verses.translation: The gopīs taste a pleasure ten million times greater than the pleasure Lord Kṛṣṇa derives from seeing them.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The wonderful characteristics of the
gopīs
are beyond imagination. They have no desire for personal satisfaction, yet when Kṛṣṇa is happy by seeing them, that happiness of Kṛṣṇa makes the
gopīs
a million times more happy than Kṛṣṇa Himself.

verses.devanagari: তাঁ সবার নাহি নিজসুখ-অনুরোধ ।\\nতথাপি বাঢ়য়ে সুখ, পড়িল বিরোধ ॥১৮৮॥
verses.transliteration: tāṅ sabāra nāhi nija-sukha-anurodha\\ntathāpi bāḍhaye sukha, paḍila virodha
verses.translation: The gopīs have no inclination for their own enjoyment, and yet their joy increases. That is indeed a contradiction.

verses.devanagari: এ বিরোধের এক মাত্র দেখি সমাধান ।\\nগোপিকার সুখ কৃষ্ণসুখে পর্যবসান ॥১৮৯॥
verses.transliteration: e virodhera eka mātra dekhi samādhāna\\ngopikāra sukha kṛṣṇa-sukhe paryavasāna
verses.translation: For this contradiction I see only one solution: the joy of the gopīs lies in the joy of their beloved Kṛṣṇa.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The situation of the
gopīs
is perplexing, for although they did not want personal happiness, it was imposed upon them. The solution to this perplexity is that Śrī Kṛṣṇa's sense of happiness is limited by the happiness of the
gopīs.
Devotees at Vṛndāvana therefore try to serve the
gopīs,
namely Rādhārāṇī and Her associates. If one gains the favor of the
gopīs,
he easily gains the favor of Kṛṣṇa because on the recommendation of the
gopīs
Kṛṣṇa at once accepts the service of a devotee. Lord Caitanya, therefore, wanted to please the
gopīs
instead of Kṛṣṇa. But His contemporaries misunderstood Him, and for this reason Lord Caitanya renounced the order of householder life and became a
sannyāsī.

verses.devanagari: গোপিকা-দর্শনে কৃষ্ণের বাঢ়ে প্রফুল্লতা ।\\nসে মাধুর্য বাঢ়ে যার নাহিক সমতা ॥১৯০॥
verses.transliteration: gopikā-darśane kṛṣṇera bāḍhe praphullatā\\nse mādhurya bāḍhe yāra nāhika samatā
verses.translation: When Lord Kṛṣṇa sees the gopīs, His joy increases, and His unparalleled sweetness increases also.

verses.devanagari: আমার দর্শনে কৃষ্ণ পাইল এত সুখ ।\\nএই সুখে গোপীর প্রফুল্ল অঙ্গমুখ ॥১৯১॥
verses.transliteration: āmāra darśane kṛṣṇa pāila eta sukha\\nei sukhe gopīra praphulla aṅga-mukha
verses.translation: [The gopīs think:] "Kṛṣṇa has obtained so much pleasure by seeing me." That thought increases the fullness and beauty of their faces and bodies.

verses.devanagari: গোপী-শোভা দেখি’ কৃষ্ণের শোভা বাঢ়ে যত ।\\nকৃষ্ণ-শোভা দেখি’ গোপীর শোভা বাঢ়ে তত ॥১৯২॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-śobhā dekhi' kṛṣṇera śobhā bāḍhe yata\\nkṛṣṇa-śobhā dekhi' gopīra śobhā bāḍhe tata
verses.translation: The beauty of Lord Kṛṣṇa increases at the sight of the beauty of the gopīs. And the more the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa's beauty, the more their beauty increases.

verses.devanagari: এইমত পরস্পর পড়ে হুড়াহুড়ি ।\\nপরস্পর বাঢ়ে, কেহ মুখ নাহি মুড়ি ॥১৯৩॥
verses.transliteration: ei-mata paraspara paḍe huḍāhuḍi\\nparaspara bāḍhe, keha mukha nāhi muḍi
verses.translation: In this way a competition takes place between them in which no one acknowledges defeat.

verses.devanagari: কিন্তু কৃষ্ণের সুখ হয় গোপী-রূপ-গুণে ।\\nতাঁর সুখে সুখবৃদ্ধি হয়ে গোপীগণে ॥১৯৪॥
verses.transliteration: kintu kṛṣṇera sukha haya gopī-rūpa-guṇe\\ntāṅra sukhe sukha-vṛddhi haye gopī-gaṇe
verses.translation: Kṛṣṇa, however, derives pleasure from the beauty and good qualities of the gopīs. And when the gopīs see His pleasure, the joy of the gopīs increases.

verses.devanagari: অতএব সেই সুখ কৃষ্ণ-সুখ পোষে ।\\nএই হেতু গোপী-প্রেমে নাহি কাম-দোষে ॥১৯৫॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva sei sukha kṛṣṇa-sukha poṣe\\nei hetu gopī-preme nāhi kāma-doṣe
verses.translation: Therefore we find that the joy of the gopīs nourishes the joy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. For that reason the fault of lust is not present in their love.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
By looking at the beautiful
gopīs
Kṛṣṇa becomes enlivened, and this enlivens the
gopīs,
whose youthful faces and bodies blossom. This competition of increasing beauty between the
gopīs
and Kṛṣṇa, which is without limitations, is so delicate that sometimes mundane moralists mistake these dealings to be purely amorous. But these affairs are not at all mundane, because the
gopīs'
intense desire to satisfy Kṛṣṇa surcharges the entire scene with pure love of Godhead, with not a spot of sexual indulgence.

verses.devanagari: উপেত্য পথি সুন্দরীততিভিরাভিরভ্যর্চিতং\\nস্মিতাঙ্কুরকরম্বিতৈর্নটদপাঙ্গভঙ্গীশতৈঃ ।\\nস্তন-স্তবকসঞ্চরন্নয়নচঞ্চরীকাঞ্চলং\\nব্রজে বিজয়িনং ভজে বিপিনদেশতঃ কেশবম্ ॥১৯৬॥
verses.transliteration: upetya pathi sundarī-tatibhir ābhir abhyarcitaṁ\\nsmitāṅkura-karambitair naṭad-apāṅga-bhaṅgī-śataiḥ\\nstana-stavaka-sañcaran-nayana-cañcarīkāñcalaṁ\\nvraje vijayinaṁ bhaje vipina-deśataḥ keśavam
verses.translation: "I worship Lord Keśava. Coming back from the forest of Vraja, He is worshiped by the gopīs, who mount the roofs of their palaces and meet Him on the path with a hundred manners of dancing glances and gentle smiles. The corners of His eyes wander, like large black bees, around the gopīs' breasts."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This statement appears in the
Keśavāṣṭaka
(8) of the
Stava-mālā,
compiled by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: আর এক গোপীপ্রেমের স্বাভাবিক চিহ্ন ।\\nযে প্রকারে হয় প্রেম কামগন্ধহীন ॥১৯৭॥
verses.transliteration: āra eka gopī-premera svābhāvika cihna\\nye prakāre haya prema kāma-gandha-hīna
verses.translation: There is another natural symptom of the gopīs' love that shows it to be without a trace of lust.

verses.devanagari: গোপীপ্রেমে করে কৃষ্ণমাধুর্যের পুষ্টি ।\\nমাধুর্যে বাঢ়ায় প্রেম হঞা মহাতুষ্টি ॥১৯৮॥
verses.transliteration: gopī-preme kare kṛṣṇa-mādhuryera puṣṭi\\nmādhurye bāḍhāya prema hañā mahā-tuṣṭi
verses.translation: The love of the gopīs nourishes the sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa. That sweetness in turn increases their love, for they are greatly satisfied.

verses.devanagari: প্রীতিবিষয়ানন্দে তদাশ্রয়ানন্দ ।\\nতাঁহা নাহি নিজসুখবাঞ্ছার সম্বন্ধ ॥১৯৯॥
verses.transliteration: prīti-viṣayānande tad-āśrayānanda\\ntāṅhā nāhi nija-sukha-vāñchāra sambandha
verses.translation: The happiness of the abode of love is in the happiness of the object of that love. This is not a relationship of desire for personal gratification.

verses.devanagari: নিরুপাধি প্রেম যাঁহা, তাঁহা এই রীতি ।\\nপ্রীতিবিষয়সুখে আশ্রয়ের প্রীতি ॥২০০॥\\nনিজ প্রেমানন্দে কৃষ্ণ-সেবানন্দ বাধে ।\\nসে আনন্দের প্রতি ভক্তের হয় মহাক্রোধে ॥২০১॥
verses.transliteration: nija-premānande kṛṣṇa-sevānanda bādhe\\nse ānandera prati bhaktera haya mahā-krodhe
verses.translation: Whenever there is unselfish love, that is its style. The reservoir of love derives pleasure when the lovable object is pleased. When the pleasure of love interferes with the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the devotee becomes angry toward such ecstasy.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
As mentioned above, the
gopīs
are the predominated lovers, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the predominator, the beloved. The love of the predominated nourishes the love of the predominator. The
gopīs
had no desire for selfish enjoyment. Their feeling of happiness was indirect, for it was dependent on the pleasure of Kṛṣṇa. Causeless love of Godhead is always so. Such pure love is possible only when the predominated is made happy by the happiness of the predominator. Such unadulterated love is exemplified when the lover deprecates her happiness in service that hinders her from discharging it.

verses.devanagari: অঙ্গস্তম্ভারম্ভমুত্তুঙ্গয়ন্তং প্রেমা-\\nনন্দং দারুকো নাভ্যনন্দৎ ।\\nকংসারাতের্বীজনে যেন সাক্ষাদ-\\nক্ষোদীয়ানন্তরায়ো ব্যধায়ি ॥২০২॥
verses.transliteration: aṅga-stambhārambham uttuṅgayantaṁ\\npremānandaṁ dāruko nābhyanandat\\nkaṁsārāter vījane yena sākṣād\\nakṣodīyān antarāyo vyadhāyi
verses.translation: "Śrī Dāruka did not relish his ecstatic feelings of love, for they caused his limbs to become stunned and thus obstructed his service of fanning Lord Kṛṣṇa."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is from
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(3.2.62).

verses.devanagari: গোবিন্দপ্রেক্ষণাক্ষেপি-বাষ্পপূরাভিবর্ষিণম্ ।\\nউচ্চৈরনিন্দদানন্দমরবিন্দবিলোচনা ॥২০৩॥
verses.transliteration: govinda-prekṣaṇākṣepi-\\nbāṣpa-pūrābhivarṣiṇam\\nuccair anindad ānandam\\naravinda-vilocanā
verses.translation: "The lotus-eyed Rādhārāṇī powerfully condemned the ecstatic love that caused a flow of tears that hindered Her sight of Govinda."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse is also from
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(2.3.54).

verses.devanagari: আর শুদ্ধভক্ত কৃষ্ণ-প্রেম-সেবা বিনে ।\\nস্বসুখার্থ সালোক্যাদি না করে গ্রহণে ॥২০৪॥
verses.transliteration: āra śuddha-bhakta kṛṣṇa-prema-sevā vine\\nsva-sukhārtha sālokyādi nā kare grahaṇe
verses.translation: Furthermore, pure devotees never forsake the loving service of Lord Kṛṣṇa to aspire for their own personal pleasure through the five kinds of liberation.
verses.purport: PURPORT\nA pure devotee of Kṛṣṇa who loves Him exclusively will flatly refuse to accept any sort of liberation, beginning from merging in the body of the Lord and extending to the other varieties of liberation, such as equality of form, opulence or abode and the opulence of living near the Lord.

verses.devanagari: মদ্গুণশ্রুতিমাত্রেণ ময়ি সর্বগুহাশয়ে ।\\nমনোগতিরবিচ্ছিন্না যথা গঙ্গাম্ভসোঽম্বুধৌ ॥২০৫॥
verses.transliteration: mad-guṇa-śruti-mātreṇa\\nmayi sarva-guhāśaye\\nmano-gatir avicchinnā\\nyathā gaṅgāmbhaso 'mbudhau
verses.translation: "Just as the celestial waters of the Ganges flow unobstructed into the ocean, so when My devotees simply hear of Me, their minds come to Me, who resides in the hearts of all.

verses.devanagari: লক্ষণং ভক্তিযোগস্য নির্গুণস্য হ্যুদাহৃতম্ ।\\nঅহৈতুক্যব্যবহিতা যা ভক্তিঃ পুরুষোত্তমে ॥২০৬॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇaṁ bhakti-yogasya\\nnirguṇasya hy udāhṛtam\\nahaituky avyavahitā\\nyā bhaktiḥ puruṣottame
verses.translation: "These are the characteristics of transcendental loving service to Puruṣottama, the Supreme Personality of Godhead: it is causeless, and it cannot be obstructed in any way.

verses.devanagari: সালোক্য-সার্ষ্টি-সারূপ্য-সামীপ্যৈকত্বমপ্যুত ।\\nদীয়মানং ন গৃহ্ণন্তি বিনা মৎসেবনং জনাঃ ॥২০৭॥
verses.transliteration: sālokya-sārṣṭi-sārūpya-\\nsāmīpyaikatvam apy uta\\ndīyamānaṁ na gṛhṇanti\\nvinā mat-sevanaṁ janāḥ
verses.translation: "My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
These three verses from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(3.29.11-13) were spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the form of Kapiladeva.

verses.devanagari: মৎসেবয়া প্রতীতং তে সালোক্যাদি-চতুষ্টয়ম্ ।\\nনেচ্ছন্তি সেবয়া পূর্ণাঃ কুতোঽন্যৎ কালবিপ্লুতম্ ॥২০৮॥
verses.transliteration: mat-sevayā pratītaṁ te\\nsālokyādi-catuṣṭayam\\nnecchanti sevayā pūrṇāḥ\\nkuto 'nyat kāla-viplutam
verses.translation: "My devotees, having fulfilled their desires by serving Me, do not accept the four kinds of salvation that are easily earned by such service. Why then should they accept any pleasures that are lost in the course of time?"
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This verse from
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(9.4.67) was spoken by the Lord in connection with the characteristics of Mahārāja Ambarīṣa. Merging into the existence of the Absolute is as temporary as living in the celestial kingdom. Both of them are controlled by time; neither position is permanent.

verses.devanagari: কামগন্ধহীন স্বাভাবিক গোপী-প্রেম ।\\nনির্মল, উজ্জ্বল, শুদ্ধ যেন দগ্ধ হেম ॥২০৯॥
verses.transliteration: kama-gandha-hīna svābhāvika gopī-prema\\nnirmala, ujjvala, śuddha yena dagdha hema
verses.translation: The natural love of the gopīs is devoid of any trace of lust. It is faultless, bright and pure, like molten gold.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের সহায়, গুরু, বান্ধব, প্রেয়সী ।\\nগোপিকা হয়েন প্রিয়া শিষ্যা, সখী, দাসী ॥২১০॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera sahāya, guru, bāndhava, preyasī\\ngopikā hayena priyā śiṣyā, sakhī dāsī
verses.translation: The gopīs are the helpers, teachers, friends, wives, dear disciples, confidantes and serving maids of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: সহায়া গুরবঃ শিষ্যা ভুজিষ্যা বান্ধবাঃ স্ত্রিয়ঃ ।\\nসত্যং বদামি তে পার্থ গোপ্যঃ কিং মে ভবন্তি ন ॥২১১॥
verses.transliteration: sahāyā guravaḥ śiṣyā\\nbhujiṣyā bāndhavāḥ striyaḥ\\nsatyaṁ vadāmi te pārtha\\ngopyaḥ kiṁ me bhavanti na
verses.translation: "O Pārtha, I speak to you the truth. The gopīs are My helpers, teachers, disciples, servants, friends and consorts. I do not know what they are not to Me."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis is a verse from the\nGopī-premāmṛta.

verses.devanagari: গোপিকা জানেন কৃষ্ণের মনের বাঞ্ছিত ।\\nপ্রেমসেবা-পরিপাটী, ইষ্ট-সমীহিত ॥২১২॥
verses.transliteration: gopikā jānena kṛṣṇera manera vāñchita\\nprema-sevā-paripāṭī, iṣṭa-samīhita
verses.translation: The gopīs know Kṛṣṇa's desires, and they know how to render perfect loving service for His enjoyment. They perform their service expertly for the satisfaction of their beloved.

verses.devanagari: মন্মাহাত্ম্যং মৎসপর্যাং মাচ্ছ্রদ্ধাং মন্মনোগতম্ ।\\nজানন্তি গোপিকাঃ পার্থ নান্যে জানন্তি তত্ত্বতঃ ॥২১৩॥
verses.transliteration: man-māhātmyaṁ mat-saparyāṁ\\nmac-chraddhāṁ man-mano-gatam\\njānanti gopikāḥ pārtha\\nnānye jānanti tattvataḥ
verses.translation: "O Pārtha, the gopīs know My greatness, My loving service, respect for Me, and My mentality. Others cannot really know these."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis verse was spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa to Arjuna in the\nĀdi Purāṇa.

verses.devanagari: সেই গোপীগণ-মধ্যে উত্তমা রাধিকা ।\\nরূপে, গুণে, সৌভাগ্যে, প্রেমে সর্বাধিকা ॥২১৪॥
verses.transliteration: sei gopī-gaṇa-madhye uttamā rādhikā\\nrūpe, guṇe, saubhāgye, preme sarvādhikā
verses.translation: Among the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhikā is the foremost. She surpasses all in beauty, in good qualities, in good fortune and, above all, in love.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Among all the
gopīs,
Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the most exalted. She is the most beautiful, the most qualified, and above all the greatest lover of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: যথা রাধা প্রিয়া বিষ্ণোস্তস্যাঃ কুণ্ডং প্রিয়ং তথা ।\\nসর্বগোপীষু সৈবৈকা বিষ্ণোরত্যন্তবল্লভা ॥২১৫॥
verses.transliteration: yathā rādhā priyā viṣṇos\\ntasyāḥ kuṇḍaṁ priyaṁ tathā\\nsarva-gopīṣu saivaikā\\nviṣṇor atyanta-vallabhā
verses.translation: "Just as Rādhā is dear to Lord Kṛṣṇa, so Her bathing place [Rādhā-kuṇḍa] is  dear to Him. She alone is His most beloved of all the gopīs."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis verse is from the\nPadma Purāṇa.

verses.devanagari: ত্রৈলোক্যে পৃথিবী ধন্যা যত্র বৃন্দাবনং পুরী ।\\nতত্রাপি গোপিকাঃ পার্থ যত্র রাধাভিধা মম ॥২১৬॥
verses.transliteration: trai-lokye pṛthivī dhanyā\\nyatra vṛndāvanaṁ purī\\ntatrāpi gopikāḥ pārtha\\nyatra rādhābhidhā mama
verses.translation: "O Pārtha, in all the three planetary systems, this earth is especially fortunate, for on earth is the town of Vṛndāvana. And there the gopīs are especially glorious because among them is My Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."
verses.purport: PURPORT\nThis verse, spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa to Arjuna, is cited from the\nĀdi Purāṇa.

verses.devanagari: রাধাসহ ক্রীড়া রস-বৃদ্ধির কারণ ।\\nআর সব গোপীগণ রসোপকরণ ॥২১৭॥
verses.transliteration: rādhā-saha krīḍā rasa-vṛddhira kāraṇa\\nāra saba gopī-gaṇa rasopakaraṇa
verses.translation: All the other gopīs help increase the joy of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes with Rādhārāṇī. The gopīs act as the instruments of Their mutual enjoyment.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
It is said that the
gopīs
are divided into five groups, namely the
sakhīs, nitya-sakhīs, prāṇa-sakhīs, priya-sakhīs
and
parama-preṣṭha-sakhīs.
All these fair-complexioned associates of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, the Queen of Vṛndāvana-dhāma, are expert artists in evoking erotic sentiments in Kṛṣṇa. The
parama-preṣṭha-sakhīs
are eight in number, and in the ecstatic dealings of Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā they side sometimes with Kṛṣṇa and at other times with Rādhārāṇī, just to create a situation in which it appears that they favor one against the other. That makes the exchange of mellows more palatable.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের বল্লভা রাধা কৃষ্ণ-প্রাণধন ।\\nতাঁহা বিনু সুখহেতু নহে গোপীগণ ॥২১৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera vallabhā rādhā kṛṣṇa-prāṇa-dhana\\ntāṅhā vinu sukha-hetu nahe gopī-gaṇa
verses.translation: Rādhā is the beloved consort of Kṛṣṇa, and She is the wealth of His life. Without Her, the gopīs cannot give Him pleasure.

verses.devanagari: কংসারিরপি সংসারবাসনাবদ্ধশৃঙ্খলাম্ ।\\nরাধামাধায় হৃদয়ে তত্যাজ ব্রজসুন্দরীঃ ॥২১৯॥
verses.transliteration: kaṁsārir api saṁsāra-\\nvāsanā-baddha-śṛṅkhalām\\nrādhām ādhāya hṛdaye\\ntatyāja vraja-sundarīḥ
verses.translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa, left aside the other gopīs during the rāsa dance and took Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to His heart, for She is the helper of the Lord in realizing the essence of His desires."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
In this verse from the
Gīta-govinda
(3.1), Jayadeva Gosvāmī describes Śrī Kṛṣṇa's leaving the
rāsa-līlā
to search for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

verses.devanagari: সেই রাধার ভাব লঞা চৈতন্যাবতার ।\\nযুগধর্ম নাম-প্রেম কৈল পরচার ॥২২০॥
verses.transliteration: sei rādhāra bhāva lañā caitanyāvatāra\\nyuga-dharma nāma-prema kaila paracāra
verses.translation: Lord Caitanya appeared with the sentiment of Rādhā. He preached the dharma of this age—the chanting of the holy name and pure love of God.

verses.devanagari: সেই ভাবে নিজবাঞ্ছা করিল পূরণ ।\\nঅবতারের এই বাঞ্ছা মূল-কারণ ॥২২১॥
verses.transliteration: sei bhāve nija-vāñchā karila pūraṇa\\navatārera ei vāñchā mūla-kāraṇa
verses.translation: In the mood of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, He also fulfilled His own desires. This is the principal reason for His appearance.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য গোসাঞি ব্রজেন্দ্রকুমার ।\\nরসময়-মূর্তি কৃষ্ণ সাক্ষাৎ শৃঙ্গার ॥২২২॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya gosāñi vrajendra-kumāra\\nrasa-maya-mūrti kṛṣṇa sākṣāt śṛṅgāra
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is Kṛṣṇa [Vrajendra-kumāra], the embodiment of rasas. He is amorous love personified.

verses.devanagari: সেই রস আস্বাদিতে কৈল অবতার ।\\nআনুষঙ্গে কৈল সব রসের প্রচার ॥২২৩॥
verses.transliteration: sei rasa āsvādite kaila avatāra\\nānusaṅge kaila saba rasera pracāra
verses.translation: He made His appearance to taste that conjugal mellow and incidentally to broadcast all the rasas.

verses.devanagari: বিশ্বেষামনুরঞ্জনেন জনয়ন্নানন্দমিন্দীবর-\\nশ্রেণীশ্যামলকোমলৈরুপনয়ন্নঙ্গৈরনঙ্গোৎসবম্ ।\\nস্বচ্ছন্দং ব্রজসুন্দরীভিরভিতঃ প্রত্যঙ্গমালিঙ্গিতঃ\\nশৃঙ্গারঃ সখি মূর্তিমানিব মধৌ মুগ্ধো হরিঃ ক্রীড়তি ॥২২৪॥
verses.transliteration: viśveṣām anurañjanena janayann ānandam indīvara-\\nśreṇī-śyāmala-komalair upanayann aṅgair anaṅgotsavam\\nsvacchandaṁ vraja-sundarībhir abhitaḥ praty-aṅgam āliṅgitaḥ\\nśṛṅgāraḥ sakhi mūrtimān iva madhau mugdho hariḥ krīḍati
verses.translation: "My dear friends, just see how Śrī Kṛṣṇa is enjoying the season of spring! With the gopīs embracing each of His limbs, He is like amorous love personified. With His transcendental pastimes, He enlivens all the gopīs and the entire creation. With His soft bluish-black arms and legs, which resemble blue lotus flowers, He has created a festival for Cupid."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a verse from the
Gīta-govinda
(1.11).

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য গোসাঞি রসের সদন ।\\nঅশেষ-বিশেষে কৈল রস আস্বাদন ॥২২৫॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya gosāñi rasera sadana\\naśeṣa-viśeṣe kaila rasa āsvādana
verses.translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the abode of rasa. He Himself tasted the sweetness of rasa in endless ways.

verses.devanagari: সেই দ্বারে প্রবর্তাইল কলিযুগ-ধর্ম ।\\nচৈতন্যের দাসে জানে এই সব মর্ম ॥২২৬॥
verses.transliteration: sei dvāre pravartāila kali-yuga-dharma\\ncaitanyera dāse jāne ei saba marma
verses.translation: Thus He initiated the dharma for the Age of Kali. The devotees of Lord Caitanya know all these truths.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Lord Caitanya is Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, the absolute enjoyer of the love of the
gopīs.
He Himself assumes the role of the
gopīs
to taste the predominated happiness of transcendental mellows. He appeared in that mode, but simultaneously He propagated the religious process for this age in a most fascinating way. Only the confidential devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand this transcendental secret.

verses.devanagari: অদ্বৈত আচার্য, নিত্যানন্দ, শ্রীনিবাস ।\\nগদাধর, দামোদর, মুরারি, হরিদাস ॥২২৭॥\\nআর যত চৈতন্য-কৃষ্ণের ভক্তগণ ।\\nভক্তিভাবে শিরে ধরি সবার চরণ ॥২২৮॥
verses.transliteration: āra yata caitanya-kṛṣṇera bhakta-gaṇa\\nbhakti-bhāve śire dhari sabāra caraṇa
verses.translation: Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda, Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita, Gadādhara, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Murāri Gupta, Haridāsa and all the other devotees of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya—bowing down with devotion, I hold their lotus feet on my head.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
The author of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta
teaches us that we must offer our respectful obeisances to all such pure confidential devotees of Lord Caitanya if we indeed want to know Him in truth.

verses.devanagari: ষষ্ঠশ্লোকের এই কহিল আভাস ।\\nমূল শ্লোকের অর্থ শুন করিয়ে প্রকাশ ॥২২৯॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭha-ślokera ei kahila ābhāsa\\nmūla ślokera artha śuna kariye prakāśa
verses.translation: I have given a hint of the sixth verse. Now please hear as I reveal the meaning of that original verse.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীরাধায়াঃ প্রণয়মহিমা কীদৃশো বানয়ৈবা-\\nস্বাদ্যো যেনাদ্ভুতমধুরিমা কীদৃশো বা মদীয়ঃ ।\\nসৌখ্যঞ্চাস্যা মদনুভবতঃ কীদৃশং বেতি লোভা-\\nত্তদ্ভাবাঢ্যঃ সমজনি শচীগর্ভসিন্ধৌ হরীন্দুঃ ॥২৩০॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-rādhāyāḥ praṇaya-mahimā kīdṛśo vānayaivā-\\nsvādyo yenādbhuta-madhurimā kīdṛśo vā madīyaḥ\\nsaukhyaṁ cāsyā mad-anubhavataḥ kīdṛśaṁ veti lobhāt\\ntad-bhāvāḍhyaḥ samajani śacī-garbha-sindhau harīnduḥ
verses.translation: "Desiring to understand the glory of Rādhārāṇī's love, the wonderful qualities in Him that She alone relishes through Her love, and the happiness She feels when She realizes the sweetness of His love, the Supreme Lord Hari, richly endowed with Her emotions, appeared from the womb of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, as the moon appeared from the ocean."

verses.devanagari: এ সব সিদ্ধান্ত গূঢ়, — কহিতে না যুয়ায় ।\\nনা কহিলে, কেহ ইহার অন্ত নাহি পায় ॥২৩১॥
verses.transliteration: e saba siddhānta gūḍha,—kahite nā yuyāya\\nnā kahile, keha ihāra anta nāhi pāya
verses.translation: All these conclusions are unfit to disclose in public. But if they are not disclosed, no one will understand them.

verses.devanagari: অতএব কহি কিছু করিঞা নিগূঢ় ।\\nবুঝিবে রসিক ভক্ত, না বুঝিবে মূঢ় ॥২৩২॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva kahi kichu kariñā nigūḍha\\nbujhibe rasika bhakta, nā bujhibe mūḍha
verses.translation: Therefore I shall mention them, revealing only their essence, so that loving devotees will understand them but fools will not.

verses.devanagari: হৃদয়ে ধরয়ে যে চৈতন্য-নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nএসব সিদ্ধান্তে সেই পাইবে আনন্দ ॥২৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: hṛdaye dharaye ye caitanya-nityānanda\\ne-saba siddhānte sei pāibe ānanda
verses.translation: Anyone who has captured Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu in his heart will become blissful by hearing all these transcendental conclusions.

verses.devanagari: এ সব সিদ্ধান্ত হয় আম্রের পল্লব ।\\nভক্তগণ-কোকিলের সর্বদা বল্লভ ॥২৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: e saba siddhānta haya āmrera pallava\\nbhakta-gaṇa-kokilera sarvadā vallabha
verses.translation: All these conclusions are like the newly grown twigs of a mango tree; they are always pleasing to the devotees, who in this way resemble cuckoo birds.

verses.devanagari: অভক্ত-উষ্ট্রের ইথে না হয় প্রবেশ ।\\nতবে চিত্তে হয় মোর আনন্দ-বিশেষ ॥২৩৫॥
verses.transliteration: abhakta-uṣṭrera ithe nā haya praveśa\\ntabe citte haya mora ānanda-viśeṣa
verses.translation: The camellike nondevotees cannot enter into these topics. Therefore there is special jubilation in my heart.

verses.devanagari: যে লাগি কহিতে ভয়, সে যদি না জানে ।\\nইহা বই কিবা সুখ আছে ত্রিভুবনে ॥২৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: ye lāgi kahite bhaya, se yadi nā jāne\\nihā va-i kibā sukha āche tribhuvane
verses.translation: For fear of them I do not wish to speak, but if they do not understand, then what can be happier in all the three worlds?

verses.devanagari: অতএব ভক্তগণে করি নমস্কার ।\\nনিঃশঙ্কে কহিয়ে, তার হউক্ চমৎকার ॥২৩৭॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva bhakta-gaṇe kari namaskāra\\nnihśaṅke kahiye, tāra hauk camatkāra
verses.translation: Therefore after offering obeisances to the devotees, for their satisfaction I shall speak without hesitating.

verses.devanagari: কৃষ্ণের বিচার এক আছয়ে অন্তরে ।\\nপূর্ণানন্দ-পূর্ণরসরূপ কহে মোরে ॥২৩৮॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇera vicara eka āchaye antare\\npūrṇānanda-pūrṇa-rasa-rūpa kahe more
verses.translation: Once Lord Kṛṣṇa considered within His heart, "Everyone says that I am complete bliss, full of all rasas.

verses.devanagari: আমা হইতে আনন্দিত হয় ত্রিভুবন ।\\nআমাকে আনন্দ দিবে — ঐছে কোন্ জন ॥২৩৯॥
verses.transliteration: āmā ha-ite ānandita haya tribhuvana\\nāmāke ānanda dibe—aiche kon jana
verses.translation: "All the world derives pleasure from Me. Is there anyone who can give Me pleasure?

verses.devanagari: আমা হৈতে যার হয় শত শত গুণ ।\\nসেইজন আহ্লাদিতে পারে মোর মন ॥২৪০॥
verses.transliteration: āmā haite yāra haya śata śata guṇa\\nsei-jana āhlādite pāre mora mana
verses.translation: "One who has a hundred times more qualities than Me could give pleasure to My mind.

verses.devanagari: আমা হৈতে গুণী বড় জগতে অসম্ভব ।\\nএকলি রাধাতে তাহা করি অনুভব ॥২৪১॥
verses.transliteration: āmā haite guṇī baḍa jagate asambhava\\nekali rādhāte tāhā kari anubhava
verses.translation: "One more qualified than Me is impossible to find in the world. But in Rādhā alone I feel the presence of one who can give Me pleasure.

verses.devanagari: কোটিকাম জিনি’ রূপ যদ্যপি আমার ।\\nঅসমোর্ধ্বমাধুর্য — সাম্য নাহি যার ॥২৪২॥\\nমোর রূপে আপ্যায়িত হয় ত্রিভুবন ।\\nরাধার দর্শনে মোর জুড়ায় নয়ন ॥২৪৩॥
verses.transliteration: mora rūpe āpyāyita haya tribhuvana\\nrādhāra darśane mora juḍāya nayana
verses.translation: "Although My beauty defeats the beauty of ten million Cupids, although it is unequaled and unsurpassed and although it gives pleasure to the three worlds, seeing Rādhārāṇī gives pleasure to My eyes.

verses.devanagari: মোর বংশী-গীতে আকর্ষয়ে ত্রিভুবন ।\\nরাধার বচনে হরে আমার শ্রবণ ॥২৪৪॥
verses.transliteration: mora vaṁśī-gīte ākarṣaye tri-bhuvana\\nrādhāra vacane hare āmāra śravaṇa
verses.translation: "The vibration of My transcendental flute attracts the three worlds, but My ears are enchanted by the sweet words of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি আমার গন্ধে জগৎ সুগন্ধ ।\\nমোর চিত্ত-প্রাণ হরে রাধা-অঙ্গ-গন্ধ ॥২৪৫॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi āmāra gandhe jagat sugandha\\nmora citta-prāṇa hare rādhā-aṅga-gandha
verses.translation: "Although My body lends fragrance to the entire creation, the scent of Rādhārāṇī's limbs captivates My mind and heart.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি আমার রসে জগৎ সরস ।\\nরাধার অধর-রস আমা করে বশ ॥২৪৬॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi āmāra rase jagat sarasa\\nrādhāra adhara-rasa āmā kare vaśa
verses.translation: "Although the entire creation is full of different tastes because of Me, I am charmed by the nectarean taste of the lips of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

verses.devanagari: যদ্যপি আমার স্পর্শ কোটিন্দু-শীতল ।\\nরাধিকার স্পর্শে আমা করে সুশীতল ॥২৪৭॥
verses.transliteration: yadyapi āmāra sparśa koṭīndu-śītala\\nrādhikāra sparśe āmā kare suśītala
verses.translation: "And although My touch is cooler than ten million moons, I am refreshed by the touch of Śrīmatī Rādhikā.

verses.devanagari: এই মত জগতের সুখে আমি হেতু ।\\nরাধিকার রূপগুণ আমার জীবাতু ॥২৪৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata jagatera sukhe āmi hetu\\nrādhikāra rūpa-guṇa āmāra jīvātu
verses.translation: "Thus although I am the source for the happiness of the entire world, the beauty and attributes of Śrī Rādhikā are My life and soul.

verses.devanagari: এই মত অনুভব আমার প্রতীত ।\\nবিচারি’ দেখিয়ে যদি, সব বিপরীত ॥২৪৯॥
verses.transliteration: ei mata anubhava āmāra pratīta\\nvicāri' dekhiye yadi, saba viparīta
verses.translation: "In this way My affectionate feelings for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī may be understood, but on analysis I find them contradictory.

verses.devanagari: রাধার দর্শনে মোর জুড়ায় নয়ন ।\\nআমার দর্শনে রাধা সুখে অগেয়ান ॥২৫০॥
verses.transliteration: rādhāra darśane mora juḍāya nayana\\nāmāra darśane rādhā sukhe ageyāna
verses.translation: "My eyes are fully satisfied when I look upon Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, but by looking upon Me, She becomes even more advanced in satisfaction.

verses.devanagari: পরস্পর বেণুগীতে হরয়ে চেতন ।\\nমোর ভ্রমে তমালেরে করে আলিঙ্গন ॥২৫১॥
