In verses 296 through 301 the emotional devoted service of Śrī Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita Prabhu and others has been fully described. Describing such individual service, the
Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā,
verses 11 through 16, declares that although Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared as a devotee, He is none other than the son of Nanda Mahārāja. Similarly, although Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu appeared as Lord Caitanya's assistant, He is none other than Baladeva, the carrier of the plow. Advaita Ācārya is the incarnation of Sadāśiva from the spiritual world. All the devotees headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura are His marginal energy, whereas the devotees headed by Gadādhara Paṇḍita are manifestations of His internal potency.
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Advaita Prabhu and Nityānanda Prabhu all belong to the
viṣṇu-tattva
category. Because Lord Caitanya is an ocean of mercy, He is addressed as
mahāprabhu,
whereas Nityānanda and Advaita, being two great personalities who assist Lord Caitanya, are addressed as
prabhu.
Thus there are two
prabhus
and one
mahāprabhu.
Gadādhara Gosvāmī is a representative of a perfect
brāhmaṇa
spiritual master. Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura represents a perfect
brāhmaṇa
devotee. These five are known as the Pañca-tattva.

verses.devanagari: তিহঁ শ্যাম, — বংশীমুখ, গোপবিলাসী ।\\nইহঁ গৌর — কভু দ্বিজ, কভু ত’ সন্ন্যাসী ॥৩০২॥
verses.transliteration: tihaṅ śyāma,—vaṁśī-mukha, gopa-vilāsī\\nihaṅ gaura—kabhu dvija, kabhu ta' sannyāsī
verses.translation: In kṛṣṇa-lilā the Lord's complexion is blackish. Holding a flute in His mouth, He enjoys as a cowherd boy. Now the selfsame person has appeared with a fair complexion, sometimes acting as a brāhmaṇa and sometimes accepting the renounced order of life.

verses.devanagari: অতএব আপনে প্রভু গোপীভাব ধরি’ ।\\nব্রজেন্দ্রনন্দনে কহে ‘প্রাণনাথ’ করি’ ॥৩০৩॥
verses.transliteration: ataeva āpane prabhu gopī-bhāva dhari'\\nvrajendra-nandane kahe 'prāṇa-nātha' kari'
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord Himself, accepting the emotional ecstasy of the gopīs, now addresses the son of Nanda Mahārāja, "O master of My life! O My dear husband!"

verses.devanagari: সেই কৃষ্ণ, সেই গোপী, — পরম বিরোধ ।\\nঅচিন্ত্য চরিত্র প্রভুর অতি সুদুর্বোধ ॥৩০৪॥
verses.transliteration: sei kṛṣṇa, sei gopī,—parama virodha\\nacintya caritra prabhura ati sudurbodha
verses.translation: He is Kṛṣṇa, yet He has accepted the mood of the gopīs. How is it so? It is the inconceivable character of the Lord, which is very difficult to understand.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Kṛṣṇa's accepting the part of the
gopīs
is certainly contradictory according to any mundane calculations, but the Lord, by His inconceivable character, may act like the
gopīs
and feel separation from Kṛṣṇa, although He is Kṛṣṇa Himself. Such a contradiction can be reconciled only in the Supreme Personality of Godhead because He has energy that is inconceivable (
acintya
), which can make possible that which is impossible to do (
aghaṭa-ghaṭana-patīyasī
). Such contradictions are very difficult to understand unless a devotee strictly follows the Vaiṣṇava philosophy under the direction of the Gosvāmīs. Therefore Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī ends every chapter with this verse:
śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
"Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta,
following in their footsteps."
In a song by Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura it is stated:
rūpa-raghunātha-pade ha-ibe ākuti
kabe hāma bujhaba se yugala-pīriti
The conjugal love between Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, which is called
yugala-pīriti,
is not understandable by mundane scholars, artists or poets. It is simply to be understood by devotees who strictly follow in the footsteps of the six Gosvāmīs. Sometimes so-called artists and poets try to understand the love affairs of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and they publish cheap books of poetry and pictures on the subject. Unfortunately, however, they do not understand the transcendental affairs of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa even to the smallest degree. They are simply meddling in a matter in which they are not fit even to enter.

verses.devanagari: ইথে তর্ক করি’ কেহ না কর সংশয় ।\\nকৃষ্ণের অচিন্ত্যশক্তি এই মত হয় ॥৩০৫॥
verses.transliteration: ithe tarka kari' keha nā kara saṁśaya\\nkṛṣṇera acintya-śakti ei mata haya
verses.translation: One cannot understand the contradictions in Lord Caitanya's character by putting forward mundane logic and arguments. Consequently one should not maintain doubts in this connection. One should simply try to understand the inconceivable energy of Kṛṣṇa; otherwise one cannot understand how such contradictions are possible.

verses.devanagari: অচিন্ত্য, অদ্ভুত কৃষ্ণচৈতন্য-বিহার ।\\nচিত্র ভাব, চিত্র গুণ, চিত্র ব্যবহার ॥৩০৬॥
verses.transliteration: acintya, adbhuta kṛṣṇa-caitanya-vihāra\\ncitra bhāva, citra guṇa, citra vyavahāra
verses.translation: The pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu are inconceivable and wonderful. His ecstasy is wonderful, His qualities are wonderful, and His behavior is wonderful.

verses.devanagari: তর্কে ইহা নাহি মানে যেই দুরাচার ।\\nকুম্ভীপাকে পচে, তার নাহিক নিস্তার ॥৩০৭॥
verses.transliteration: tarke ihā nāhi māne yei durācāra\\nkumbhīpāke pace, tāra nāhika nistāra
verses.translation: If one simply adheres to mundane arguments and therefore does not accept this, he will boil in the hell of Kumbhīpāka. For him there is no deliverance.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
Kumbhīpāka, a type of hellish condition, is described in
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam
(5.26.13), wherein it is said that a person who cooks living birds and beasts to satisfy his tongue is brought before Yamarāja after death and punished in the Kumbhīpāka hell. There he is put into boiling oil called
kumbhī-pāka,
from which there is no deliverance. Kumbhīpāka is meant for persons who are unnecessarily envious. Those who are envious of the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are punished in that hellish condition.

verses.devanagari: অচিন্ত্যাঃ খলু যে ভাবা ন তাংস্তর্কেণ যোজয়েৎ ।\\nপ্রকৃতিভ্যঃ পরং যচ্চ তদচিন্ত্যস্য লক্ষণম ॥৩০৮॥
verses.transliteration: acintyāḥ khalu ye bhāvā\\nna tāṁs tarkeṇa yojayet\\nprakṛtibhyaḥ paraṁ yac ca\\ntad acintyasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: "Anything transcendental to material nature is called inconceivable, whereas arguments are all mundane. Since mundane arguments cannot touch transcendental subject matters, one should not try to understand transcendental subjects through mundane arguments."
verses.purport:
PURPORT
This is a quote from the
Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu
(2.5.93), by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

verses.devanagari: অদ্ভুত চৈতন্যলীলায় যাহার বিশ্বাস ।\\nসেই জন যায় চৈতন্যের পদ পাশ ॥৩০৯॥
verses.transliteration: adbhuta caitanya-līlāya yāhāra viśvāsa\\nsei jana yāya caitanyera pada pāśa
verses.translation: Only a person who has firm faith in the wonderful pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu can approach His lotus feet.

verses.devanagari: প্রসঙ্গে কহিল এই সিদ্ধান্তের সার ।\\nইহা যেই শুনে, শুদ্ধভক্তি হয় তার ॥৩১০॥
verses.transliteration: prasaṅge kahila ei siddhāntera sāra\\nihā yei śune, śuddha-bhakti haya tāra
verses.translation: In this discourse I have explained the essence of the devotional conclusion. Anyone who hears this develops unalloyed devotional service to the Lord.

verses.devanagari: লিখিত গ্রন্থের যদি করি অনুবাদ ।\\nতবে সে গ্রন্থের অর্থ পাইয়ে আস্বাদ ॥৩১১॥
verses.transliteration: likhita granthera yadi kari anuvāda\\ntabe se granthera artha pāiye āsvāda
verses.translation: If I repeat what is already written, I may thus relish the purpose of this scripture.

verses.devanagari: দেখি গ্রন্থে ভাগবতে ব্যাসের আচার ।\\nকথা কহি’ অনুবাদ করে বার বার ॥৩১২॥
verses.transliteration: dekhi granthe bhāgavate vyāsera ācāra\\nkathā kahi' anuvāda kare vāra vāra
verses.translation: We can see in the scripture Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam the conduct of its author, Śrī Vyāsadeva. After speaking the narration, he repeats it again and again.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
At the end of
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,
in the Twelfth Canto, the Twelfth Chapter has fifty-two verses in which Śrī Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana Vedavyāsa recapitulates
Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam's
entire subject matter. Śrī Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī wants to follow in the footsteps of Śrī Vyāsadeva by recapitulating the seventeen chapters of
Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta's Ādi-līlā.

verses.devanagari: তাতে আদি-লীলার করি পরিচ্ছেদ গণন ।\\nপ্রথম পরিচ্ছেদে কৈলুঁ ‘মঙ্গলাচরণ’ ॥৩১৩॥
verses.transliteration: tāte ādi-līlāra kari pariccheda gaṇana\\nprathama paricchede kailuṅ 'maṅgalācaraṇa'
verses.translation: Therefore I shall enumerate the chapters of the Ādi-līlā. In the First Chapter I offer obeisances to the spiritual master, for this is the beginning of auspicious writing.

verses.devanagari: দ্বিতীয় পরিচ্ছেদে ‘চৈতন্যতত্ত্ব-নিরূপণ’ ।\\nস্বয়ং ভগবান্ যেই ব্রজেন্দ্র নন্দন ॥৩১৪॥
verses.transliteration: dvitīya paricchede 'caitanya-tattva-nirūpaṇa'\\nsvayaṁ bhagavān yei vrajendra-nandana
verses.translation: The Second Chapter explains the truth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda.

verses.devanagari: তেঁহো ত’ চৈতন্য-কৃষ্ণ — শচীর নন্দন ।\\nতৃতীয় পরিচ্ছেদে জন্মের ‘সামান্য’ কারণ ॥৩১৫॥
verses.transliteration: teṅho ta' caitanya-kṛṣṇa—śacīra nandana\\ntṛtīya paricchede janmera 'sāmānya' kāraṇa
verses.translation: Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is Kṛṣṇa Himself, has now appeared as the son of mother Śacī. The Third Chapter describes the general cause of His appearance.

verses.devanagari: তহিঁ মধ্যে প্রেমদান — ‘বিশেষ’ কারণ ।\\nযুগধর্ম — কৃষ্ণনাম-প্রেম-প্রচারণ ॥৩১৬॥
verses.transliteration: tahiṅ madhye prema-dāna—'viśeṣa' kāraṇa\\nyuga-dharma—kṛṣṇa-nāma-prema-pracāraṇa
verses.translation: The Third Chapter specifically describes the distribution of love of Godhead. It also describes the religion of the age, which is simply to distribute the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa and propagate the process of loving Him.

verses.devanagari: চতুর্থে কহিলুঁ জন্মের ‘মূল’ প্রয়োজন ।\\nস্বমাধুর্য-প্রেমানন্দরস-আস্বাদন ॥৩১৭॥
verses.transliteration: caturthe kahiluṅ janmera 'mūla' prayojana\\nsva-mādhurya-premānanda-rasa-āsvādana
verses.translation: The Fourth Chapter describes the main reason for His appearance, which is to taste the mellow quality of His own transcendental loving service and His own sweetness.

verses.devanagari: পঞ্চমে ‘শ্রীনিত্যানন্দ’-তত্ত্ব নিরূপণ ।\\nনিত্যানন্দ হৈলা রাম রোহিণীনন্দন ॥৩১৮॥
verses.transliteration: pañcame 'śrī-nityānanda'-tattva nirūpaṇa\\nnityānanda hailā rāma rohiṇī-nandana
verses.translation: The Fifth Chapter describes the truth of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, who is none other than Balarāma, the son of Rohiṇī.

verses.devanagari: ষষ্ঠ পরিচ্ছেদে ‘অদ্বৈত-তত্ত্বে’র বিচার ।\\nঅদ্বৈত-আচার্য — মহাবিষ্ণু-অবতার ॥৩১৯॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭha paricchede 'advaita-tattve'ra vicāra\\nadvaita-ācārya—mahā-viṣṇu-avatāra
verses.translation: The Sixth Chapter considers the truth of Advaita Ācārya. He is an incarnation of Mahā-Viṣṇu.

verses.devanagari: সপ্তম পরিচ্ছেদে ‘পঞ্চতত্ত্বে’র আখ্যান ।\\nপঞ্চতত্ত্ব মিলি’ যৈছে কৈলা প্রেমদান ॥৩২০॥
verses.transliteration: saptama paricchede 'pañca-tattve'ra ākhyāna\\npañca-tattva mili' yaiche kailā prema-dāna
verses.translation: The Seventh Chapter describes the Pañca-tattva-Śrī Caitanya, Prabhu Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita, Gadādhara and Śrīvāsa. They all combined together to distribute love of Godhead everywhere.

verses.devanagari: অষ্টমে ‘চৈতন্যলীলা-বর্ণন’-কারণ ।\\nএক কৃষ্ণনামের মহা-মহিমা-কথন ॥৩২১॥
verses.transliteration: aṣṭame 'caitanya-līlā-varṇana'-kāraṇa\\neka kṛṣṇa-nāmera mahā-mahimā-kathana
verses.translation: The Eighth Chapter gives the reason for describing Lord Caitanya's pastimes. It also describes the greatness of Lord Kṛṣṇa's holy name.

verses.devanagari: নবমেতে ‘ভক্তিকল্পবৃক্ষের বর্ণন’ ।\\nশ্রীচৈতন্য-মালী কৈলা বৃক্ষ আরোপণ ॥৩২২॥
verses.transliteration: navamete 'bhakti-kalpa-vṛkṣera varṇana'\\nśrī-caitanya-mālī kailā vṛkṣa āropaṇa
verses.translation: The Ninth Chapter describes the desire tree of devotional service. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself is the gardener who planted it.

verses.devanagari: দশমেতে মূল-স্কন্ধের ‘শাখাদি-গণন’ ।\\nসর্বশাখাগণের যৈছে ফল-বিতরণ ॥৩২৩॥
verses.transliteration: daśamete mūla-skandhera 'śākhādi-gaṇana'\\nsarva-śākhā-gaṇera yaiche phala-vitaraṇa
verses.translation: The Tenth Chapter describes the branches and sub-branches of the main trunk, and the distribution of their fruits.

verses.devanagari: একাদশে ‘নিত্যানন্দশাখা-বিবরণ’ ।\\nদ্বাদশে ‘অদ্বৈতস্কন্ধ শাখার বর্ণন’ ॥৩২৪॥
verses.transliteration: ekādaśe 'nityānanda-śākhā-vivaraṇa'\\ndvādaśe 'advaita-skandha śākhāra varṇana'
verses.translation: The Eleventh Chapter describes the branch called Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu. The Twelfth Chapter describes the branch called Śrī Advaita Prabhu.

verses.devanagari: ত্রয়োদশে মহাপ্রভুর ‘জন্ম-বিবরণ’ ।\\nকৃষ্ণনাম-সহ যৈছে প্রভুর জনম ॥৩২৫॥
verses.transliteration: trayodaśe mahāprabhura 'janma-vivaraṇa'\\nkṛṣṇa-nāma-saha yaiche prabhura janama
verses.translation: The Thirteenth Chapter describes the birth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, which took place with the chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.

verses.devanagari: চতুর্দশে ‘বাল্যলীলা’র কিছু বিবরণ ।\\nপঞ্চদশে ‘পৌগণ্ডলীলা’র সংক্ষেপে কথন ॥৩২৬॥
verses.transliteration: caturdaśe 'bālya-līlāra' kichu vivaraṇa\\npañcadaśe 'paugaṇḍa-līlāra' saṅkṣepe kathana
verses.translation: The Fourteenth Chapter gives some description of the Lord's childhood pastimes. The Fifteenth briefly describes the Lord's boyhood pastimes.

verses.devanagari: ষোড়শ পরিচ্ছেদে ‘কৈশোরলীলা’র উদ্দেশ ।\\nসপ্তদশে ‘যৌবনলীলা’ কহিলুঁ বিশেষ ॥৩২৭॥
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśa paricchede 'kaiśora-līlā' ra uddeśa\\nsaptadaśe 'yauvana-līlā' kahiluṅ viśeṣa
verses.translation: In the Sixteenth Chapter I have indicated the pastimes of the kaiśora age [the age prior to youth]. In the Seventeenth Chapter I have specifically described His youthful pastimes.

verses.devanagari: এই সপ্তদশ প্রকার ‘আদি-লীলা’র প্রবন্ধ ।\\nদ্বাদশ প্রবন্ধ তাতে গ্রন্থ-মুখবন্ধ ॥৩২৮॥
verses.transliteration: ei saptadaśa prakāra ādi-līlāra prabandha\\ndvādaśa prabandha tāte grantha-mukhabandha
verses.translation: Thus there are seventeen varieties of subjects in the First Canto, which is known as the Ādi-līlā. Twelve of these constitute the preface of this scripture.

verses.devanagari: পঞ্চপ্রবন্ধে পঞ্চরসের চরিত ।\\nসংক্ষেপে কহিলুঁ অতি, — না কৈলুঁ বিস্তৃত ॥৩২৯॥
verses.transliteration: pañca-prabandhe pañca-rasera carita\\nsaṅkṣepe kahiluṅ ati,—nā kailuṅ vistṛta
verses.translation: After the chapters of the preface, I have described five transcendental mellows in five chapters. I have described them very briefly rather than expansively.

verses.devanagari: বৃন্দাবনদাস ইহা ‘চৈতন্যমঙ্গলে’ ।\\nবিস্তারি’ বর্ণিলা নিত্যানন্দ-আজ্ঞা-বলে ॥৩৩০॥
verses.transliteration: vṛndāvana-dāsa ihā 'caitanya-maṅgale'\\nvistāri' varṇilā nityānanda-ājñā-bale
verses.translation: By the order and strength of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has elaborately described in his Caitanya-maṅgala all that I have not.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যলীলা — অদ্ভুত, অনন্ত ।\\nব্রহ্মা-শিব-শেষ যাঁর নাহি পায় অন্ত ॥৩৩১॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-līlā—adbhuta, ananta\\nbrahmā-śiva-śeṣa yāṅra nāhi pāya anta
verses.translation: The pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are wonderful and unlimited. Even personalities like Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva and Śeṣa Nāga cannot find their end.

verses.devanagari: যে যেই অংশ কহে, শুনে সেই ধন্য ।\\nঅচিরে মিলিবে তারে শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ॥৩৩২॥
verses.transliteration: ye yei aṁśa kahe, śune sei dhanya\\nacire milibe tāre śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
verses.translation: Anyone who describes or hears any part of this elaborate subject will very soon receive the causeless mercy of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য, অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ ।\\nশ্রীবাস-গদাধরাদি যত ভক্তবৃন্দ ॥৩৩৩॥
verses.transliteration: śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya, advaita, nityānanda\\nśrīvāsa-gadādharādi yata bhakta-vṛnda
verses.translation: [Herein the author again describes the Pañca-tattva.] Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, Prabhu Nityānanda, Śrī Advaita, Gadādhara, Śrīvāsa and all the devotees of Lord Caitanya.

verses.devanagari: যত যত ভক্তগণ বৈসে বৃন্দাবনে ।\\nনম্র হঞা শিরে ধরোঁ সবার চরণে ॥৩৩৪॥
verses.transliteration: yata yata bhakta-gaṇa vaise vṛndāvane\\nnamra hañā śire dharoṅ sabāra caraṇe
verses.translation: I offer my respectful obeisances to all the residents of Vṛndāvana. I wish to place their lotus feet on my head in great humbleness.

verses.devanagari: শ্রীস্বরূপ-শ্রীরূপ-শ্রীসনাতন ।\\nশ্রীরঘুনাথদাস, আর শ্রীজীব-চরণ ॥৩৩৫॥\\nশিরে ধরি বন্দোঁ, নিত্য করোঁ তাঁর আশ ।\\nচৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥৩৩৬॥
verses.transliteration: śire dhari vandoṅ, nitya karoṅ tāṅra āśa\\ncaitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
verses.translation: I wish to place the lotus feet of the Gosvāmīs on my head. Their names are Śrī Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī and Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī. Placing their lotus feet on my head, always hoping to serve them, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
verses.purport:
PURPORT
***
Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā,  Seventeenth Chapter, describing the pastimes of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu in His youth.
END OF THE ĀDI-LĪLĀ
